paras.en: “It’s pretty overwhelming at the moment,” she adds. “These animals, who we very much love and admire and respect … these animals are getting sick, they are suffering and then they are dying.”
paras.zh: “目前这真是令人难以承受，”她补充道。 “这些动物，我们非常喜爱、钦佩和尊重……这些动物正在生病、受苦，然后濒临死亡。”

articles.title: London's Oldest Restaurant, Frequented by Monarchs and Pop Stars Alike, Is a Site of 'Living History.' Now It's Protected by the National Trust for Generations to Come

paras.en: After more than two centuries—spanning ten British monarchs, 45 prime ministers and two world wars—London’s oldest restaurant is entering a new chapter.
paras.zh: 经过两个多世纪的历程——跨越 10 位英国君主、45 位首相和两次世界大战——伦敦最古老的餐厅正在进入新的篇章。

paras.en: Rules, a storied restaurant on Maiden Lane in Covent Garden, has changed hands only three times since opening its doors in 1798. Now, J.P. Mayhew, the building’s proprietor for the past 40 years, is donating the site, along with the art collection it houses and rent from the restaurant business, to the National Trust, a British conservation charity, per the Independent’s Emily Beament. Altogether, the donation is valued at £11 million, approximately $14.5 million.
paras.zh: Rules 是考文特花园梅登巷 (Maiden Lane) 上的一家传奇餐厅，自 1798 年开业以来仅易手过 3 次。据《独立报》的艾米丽·比门特 (Emily Beament) 报道，该建筑过去 40 年的业主 J.P. Mayhew 正在将这处场地连同其收藏和从餐厅业务租用的艺术收藏品捐赠给英国保护慈善机构国民信托基金 (National Trust)。 Altogether, the donation is valued at £11 million, approximately $14.5 million.

paras.en: “Rules is place of living history where kings, writers and politicians have dined. A place where you can see, smell and taste not only treacle sponge, but centuries of history, care and memories. A place where cultural traditions have been kept alive, and continue to thrive, despite the world around it changing,” Hilary McGrady, director-general of the National Trust, says in a statement posted to social media.
paras.zh: “Rules 是一个充满鲜活历史的地方，国王、作家和政治家曾在这里用餐。在这里，你不仅可以看到、闻到和品尝到糖蜜海绵，还可以看到几个世纪的历史、关怀和记忆。这里的文化传统一直保持活力，并继续蓬勃发展，尽管周围的世界发生了变化，”国民信托基金会总干事希拉里·麦克格雷迪在社交媒体上发布的一份声明中表示。

paras.en: The restaurant is located on a cobblestone road in the center of London’s vibrant theater district. Over the years, it has played host to countless authors, playwrights and stars, including Charles Dickens, William Makepeace Thackeray, H. G. Wells, Charlie Chaplin, Madonna and Harrison Ford.
paras.zh: 该餐厅位于伦敦充满活力的剧院区中心的一条鹅卵石路上。多年来，这里接待过无数作家、剧作家和明星，包括查尔斯·狄更斯、威廉·梅克皮斯·萨克雷、H·G·威尔斯、查理·卓别林、麦当娜和哈里森·福特。

paras.en: In all that time, Rules developed a reputation for discretion. Edward VII, who served as king of the United Kingdom between 1901 and 1910, had a private door built into the restaurant’s paneled walls so he could slip in unseen with his mistress, the socialite and actress Lillie Langtry, according to the Telegraph’s Craig Simpson.
paras.zh: 在那段时间里，《规则》赢得了谨慎的声誉。据《每日电讯报》的克雷格·辛普森报道，1901 年至 1910 年间担任英国国王的爱德华七世在餐厅的镶板墙上安装了一扇私人门，这样他就可以和他的情妇、社交名流兼演员莉莉·兰特里悄悄溜进去。

paras.en: Author Graham Greene even memorialized the restaurant’s romantic potential in his 1951 novel, The End of the Affair. “Is it possible to fall in love over a dish of onions? It seems improbable and yet I could swear it was just then that I fell in love,” Greene’s narrator muses.
paras.zh: 作家格雷厄姆·格林 (Graham Greene) 甚至在他 1951 年的小说《情事的终结》(The End of the Affair) 中纪念了这家餐厅的浪漫潜力。 “有可能因为一盘洋葱而坠入爱河吗？这似乎不太可能，但我可以发誓就在那时我坠入爱河，”格林的叙述者沉思道。

paras.en: Rules has survived crisis after crisis, staying open even during World War II. In those years, service ran for only two hours, during lunchtime, and complied with government rationing guidelines. Those wartime meals “weren’t exactly high gastronomy,” but Rules skirted the strictest restrictions by selling wild-caught grouse, pheasant and rabbit, CNN’s Chris Dwyer reported in July. To this day, Rules sells more game than any other restaurant in the country.
paras.zh: 规则在一次又一次的危机中幸存下来，甚至在第二次世界大战期间也保持开放。那些年，服务只在午餐时间运行两个小时，并且遵守政府的配给准则。据美国有线电视新闻网 (CNN) 的克里斯·德怀尔 (Chris Dwyer) 7 月报道，这些战时餐点“算不上高级美食”，但“规则”通过出售野生捕获的松鸡、野鸡和兔子来规避最严格的限制。直到今天，Rules 销售的野味比该国任何其他餐厅都多。

paras.en: Rules’ cluttered walls are a testament to its history. The restaurant’s four stories are adorned with visitor books, caricatures, portraits and signs. Many of its artifacts bear the faces and names of the high-profile guests who have warmed the restaurant’s plush chairs. Langtry, Edward VII’s mistress, even gave Rules a signed portrait of herself to thank the restaurant for its tactfulness, per the Independent.
paras.zh: Rules 杂乱的墙壁证明了它的历史。餐厅的四层楼装饰着游客手册、漫画、肖像和标志。许多文物上都刻有为餐厅的豪华椅子取暖的知名客人的面孔和名字。据《独立报》报道，爱德华七世的情妇兰特里甚至送给鲁斯一张自己签名的肖像，以感谢餐厅的机智。

paras.en: While Mayhew is donating the restaurant’s historic building and contents to the National Trust, he sold the restaurant business to Ricky McMenemy in 2022. Under the new arrangement, McMenemy will become a commercial tenant of the National Trust.
paras.zh: 虽然梅休将餐厅的历史建筑和内容捐赠给国家信托基金，但他于 2022 年将餐厅业务出售给了瑞奇·麦克梅内米 (Ricky McMenemy)。根据新安排，麦克梅内米将成为国家信托基金的商业租户。

paras.en: The Maiden Lane building will be the first in National Trust’s portfolio to house a running restaurant operation. But the charity is no stranger to historic businesses. Its portfolio currently includes 39 historic pubs and several country house hotels, according to the Guardian’s Esther Addley and George Francis Lee.
paras.zh: Maiden Lane 建筑将是国民信托投资组合中第一座经营餐厅的建筑。但该慈善机构对历史悠久的企业并不陌生。据《卫报》的埃丝特·阿德利 (Esther Addley) 和乔治·弗朗西斯·李 (George Francis Lee) 介绍，该公司的投资组合目前包括 39 家历史悠久的酒吧和几家乡村别墅酒店。

paras.en: Day-to-day operations of the restaurant will remain under the purview of McMenemy. “It will always be run as a restaurant,” National Trust national curator Lucy Porten tells the Guardian.
paras.zh: 餐厅的日常运营仍将由麦克梅内米负责。 “它将永远作为一家餐厅经营，”国家信托基金国家馆长露西·波滕告诉《卫报》。

paras.en: McMenemy tells the Independent that the donation gives him and his staff “security and peace of mind” to know that Rules will be looked after even as the restaurant industry weathers instability.
paras.zh: 麦克梅尼米告诉《独立报》，这笔捐款让他和他的员工感到“安全和安心”，因为他们知道即使餐饮业面临不稳定的情况，规则也会得到遵守。

paras.en: The charity is looking to add ways to expand access to the historic restaurant, potentially through virtual visits. In the meantime, patrons can expect the same rabbit rillettes, pork cheeks and steak and kidney pies. For anyone worried the National Trust may warp Rules with its afternoon tea sensibilities, fear not. “There will be no scones,” Porten tells the Guardian.
paras.zh: 该慈善机构正在寻求增加方法来扩大对这家历史悠久的餐厅的访问范围，可能是通过虚拟访问。与此同时，顾客可以享用同样的兔肉酱、猪颊肉以及牛排腰子馅饼。对于那些担心国民信托可能会以其下午茶敏感性扭曲规则的人来说，不用担心。 “不会有烤饼，”波滕告诉卫报。

articles.title: A Detailed Martian Rover Photograph Highlights Mysterious Cliffs on the Edge of One of Mars’ Mountains

paras.en: To the untrained eye, the photograph’s pale sky, hazy light and blue-grey foreground could have been snapped in one of Earth’s many desert landscapes. But the panorama was captured millions of miles away from our planet, on a world whose nickname stands in stark contrast with the neutral tones of the image: Mars.
paras.zh: 对于未经训练的人来说，这张照片中苍白的天空、朦胧的光线和蓝灰色的前景可能是在地球上众多沙漠景观之一中拍摄的。但这张全景图是在距离地球数百万英里的地方拍摄的，这个世界的昵称与图像的中性色调形成鲜明对比：火星。

paras.en: Indeed, NASA’s Curiosity rover used its Mastcam to snap the six images that make up the landscape on August 11 at 8:30 a.m. local Mars time, which scientists then stitched together after the rover sent them back to Earth. The final product presents the most detailed view scientists have ever had of wind-carved Martian cliffs, including crags known as yardangs.
paras.zh: 事实上，美国宇航局的好奇号火星车使用其桅杆摄像头在火星当地时间 8 月 11 日上午 8 点 30 分拍摄了构成景观的六幅图像，科学家们在火星车将它们送回地球后将这些图像拼接在一起。最终产品呈现了科学家们对风蚀火星悬崖（包括被称为雅丹的峭壁）所了解的最详细的视图。

paras.en: "This scene has a wildness that reminds me of a road trip through Monument Valley, Arizona. You can almost feel the silence and the endless open space under the sky,” Ashwin Vasavada, a planetary scientist and the Curiosity project scientist, tells Reuters’ Will Dunham. “But as familiar as that sounds, the sky is orange and the sunrise has shades of blue. It's like Earth, but it's definitely Mars.”
paras.zh: “这个场景有一种野性，让我想起穿越亚利桑那州纪念碑谷的公路旅行。你几乎可以感受到天空下的寂静和无尽的开放空间，”行星科学家、好奇号项目科学家阿什温·瓦萨瓦达 (Ashwin Vasavada) 告诉路透社的威尔·邓纳姆 (Will Dunham)。 “但这听起来很熟悉，天空是橙色的，日出是蓝色的。它就像地球，但绝对是火星。”

paras.en: The yardangs sit on the northwest side of a three-mile-tall mountain called Mount Sharp, and both features sit in Mars’ Gale Crater, according to the outlet. Curiosity landed on Mars in 2012 and has been climbing Mount Sharp since 2014. On August 26, it reached 0.6 miles of elevation, which is a record for Martian rovers.
paras.zh: 据报道，雅丹坐落在一座三英里高的夏普山的西北侧，这两个特征都位于火星的盖尔陨石坑内。好奇号于2012年登陆火星，自2014年以来一直在攀登夏普山。8月26日，它达到了0.6英里的海拔，这是火星探测器的记录。

paras.en: Mount Sharp’s layers preserve materials from different periods of Mars’ history. Their analysis has shed light on the lakes and streams that existed there billions of years ago, when the Red Planet hosted a much wetter environment. When the water dried up it left behind layers of minerals, and when the deposits stopped accumulating on Mount Sharp, wind possibly eroded the yardangs into being.
paras.zh: 夏普山的地层保存了火星历史不同时期的物质。他们的分析揭示了数十亿年前那里存在的湖泊和溪流，当时这颗红色星球的环境要湿润得多。当水干涸时，会留下一层层矿物质，当沉积物停止在夏普山上堆积时，风可能会侵蚀雅丹。

paras.en: However, “the yardang layer looks out of place. It’s the wrong color, the layers tilt at an odd angle, and it almost appears plastered on,” Vasavada says in a NASA statement. “But that’s what makes it exciting to reach. No one is sure exactly what created this layer, but one idea is it may be ash deposited by ancient volcanic eruptions.” In fact, the yardangs don’t seem to be part of the rest of Mount Sharp’s layers, Vasavada adds to Reuters.
paras.zh: 然而，“雅丹层看起来不合适。它的颜色不对，层以奇怪的角度倾斜，而且几乎看起来像是抹了灰泥的，”瓦萨瓦达在美国宇航局的一份声明中说。 “但这就是到达它令人兴奋的原因。没有人确切知道是什么创造了这一层，但一个想法是它可能是古代火山喷发沉积的火山灰。”瓦萨瓦达向路透社补充说，事实上，雅丹似乎并不属于夏普山其余层的一部分。

paras.en: Scientists are aiming for Curiosity to reach the base of the yardangs in 2027. When it launched in 2011, the rover was the largest and most capable ever sent to Mars. Curiosity’s objective is to understand if Mars could have ever hosted extraterrestrial microbes, and the rover made headlines earlier this year when it discovered organic molecules that represent the building blocks for life.
paras.zh: 科学家们的目标是让好奇号在 2027 年到达雅丹的底部。2011 年发射时，好奇号是有史以来发送到火星的最大、能力最强的火星车。好奇号的目标是了解火星是否曾经存在过外星微生物，今年早些时候，好奇号火星车发现了代表生命组成部分的有机分子，成为了头条新闻。

paras.en: Mars “had all the conditions for life to start there when life was starting on Earth,” Andrew Coates, a planetary scientist at University College London’s department of space and climate physics, told the Guardian’s Hannah Devlin at the time of the discovery. “There’s no known reason why it shouldn’t have started on Mars as well.”
paras.zh: 伦敦大学学院空间与气候物理系的行星科学家安德鲁·科茨(Andrew Coates)在发现这一发现时告诉《卫报》的汉娜·德夫林(Hannah Devlin)，“当地球上出现生命时，火星就具备了生命诞生的所有条件”。 “没有任何已知的原因可以解释为什么它不应该在火星上开始。”

paras.en: Did you know? The many instruments of Curiosity
paras.zh: 你可知道？好奇号的多种工具

paras.en: NASA's Curiosity rover on Mars was built with multiple tools and cameras.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局在火星上的好奇号探测器是用多种工具和相机建造的。

paras.en: - The Mastcam sits at about human height and is designed to take wide panoramic shots of the Mars surface
paras.zh: - 桅杆摄像机的高度约为人类高度，旨在拍摄火星表面的广角全景照片

paras.en: - MAHLI, the Mars Hand Lens Imager, provides close-up views or Martian rocks and dust.
paras.zh: - MAHLI，火星手持镜头成像仪，提供火星岩石和灰尘的特写视图。

paras.en: - Spectrometers analyze the chemical makeup of substances found on the Martian surface.
paras.zh: - 光谱仪分析火星表面物质的化学组成。

paras.en: - REMS, the Rover Enviromental Monitoring Station, is a mobile weather lab that tracks storms and atmospheric conditions on the planet.

Curiosity isn’t the only rover on the Red Planet, however. NASA’s Perseverance also recently made the news after setting a new record for the farthest distance any vehicle has ever driven on the surface of an extraterrestrial world, according to a statement by the Jet Propulsion Laboratory JPL) at the California Institute of Technology.
paras.zh: 然而，好奇号并不是这颗红色星球上唯一的火星车。 NASA’s Perseverance also recently made the news after setting a new record for the farthest distance any vehicle has ever driven on the surface of an extraterrestrial world, according to a statement by the Jet Propulsion Laboratory JPL) at the California Institute of Technology.

paras.en: "Perseverance builds on the 29-year legacy of our past Mars rovers,” Steven Lee, deputy project manager at the JPL, tells Will Dunham in a different Reuters article, “Sojourner, Spirit, Opportunity and Curiosity—each incorporating prior lessons and improving our ability to drive on another world.”
paras.zh: JPL 项目副经理史蒂文·李 (Steven Lee) 在另一篇路透社文章中对威尔·邓纳姆 (Will Dunham) 表示：“毅力号是建立在我们过去的火星漫游车 29 年遗产的基础上的。旅居者号、勇气号、机遇号和好奇号——每一项都融入了之前的经验教训，并提高了我们在另一个世界上行驶的能力。”

articles.title: Kids’ Content Is Deeply Broken. A New Platform Wants to Fix It
articles.author: Jason Parham

paras.en: If you have young kids or if you know somebody who does, then you know about YouTube’s AI slop problem.
paras.zh: 如果您有小孩，或者您认识有小孩的人，那么您就会知道 YouTube 的 AI 溢出问题。

paras.en: Videos targeted at children on the platform are often filled with bizarre and hyperstimulating content that’s AI generated. Not all of it is age-appropriate. These videos autoplay on endless, algorithmically curated streams punctuated by ads.
paras.zh: 该平台上针对儿童的视频通常充满人工智能生成的奇异且过度刺激的内容。并非所有内容都适合年龄。这些视频会在无尽的、经过算法管理的流中自动播放，中间夹杂着广告。

paras.en: Maka, a new streaming app for kids aged 0 to 6, is positioning itself as an antidote to that concern. The platform has zero ads, doesn’t allow autoplay or endless scrolling, and its algorithms intentionally do not maximize watch time.
paras.zh: Maka 是一款针对 0 至 6 岁儿童的新型流媒体应用程序，它将自己定位为解决这一问题的方法。该平台零广告，不允许自动播放或无休止滚动，并且其算法故意不最大化观看时间。

paras.en: The company’s cofounder and chief product officer Tanyella Leta tells WIRED the platform is purposely abandoning the mechanisms that “turn children’s media into an engagement machine.”
paras.zh: 该公司联合创始人兼首席产品官 Tanyella Leta 告诉《连线》杂志，该平台有意放弃“将儿童媒体变成互动机器”的机制。

paras.en: Maka’s CEO and cofounder Isabel Sheinman adds that a lot of the streamers were built to serve adults, not children. “Kids were really the afterthought,” she says. Sheinman wants to set a much higher bar for what quality looks like in children’s media, which she says has been warped by harmful incentives. “Maka was built with child development science and children's behavior first and foremost.”
paras.zh: Maka 的首席执行官兼联合创始人伊莎贝尔·谢曼 (Isabel Sheinman) 补充说，很多流媒体都是为了服务成年人，而不是儿童。 “孩子真的是事后才想到的，”她说。谢曼希望为儿童媒体的质量设定更高的标准，她说有害的激励措施已经扭曲了儿童媒体的质量。 “Maka 的建立首先考虑了儿童发展科学和儿童行为。”

paras.en: Launching today, Maka’s programming slate is a mix of licensed content from global studios and independent creators. It features 25 shows in its curated catalog, including Franklin, The Wiggles, Pocoyo, Vida the Vet and Sesame Street. The platform runs on a subscription service, with a $15 monthly plan and a $107 annual plan.
paras.zh: Maka 今天推出的节目板包含了来自全球工作室和独立创作者的授权内容。其策划目录中有 25 场演出，包括 Franklin、The Wiggles、Pocoyo、Vida the Vet 和 Sesame Street。该平台采用订阅服务，每月计划 15 美元，年度计划 107 美元。

paras.en: It was during the Covid pandemic that Sheinman and Leta became obsessed with thinking about how to redesign kids' media. The solution? Every episode streamed on Maka is evaluated by child development experts through Imprint, a framework created with researchers at the Yale Child Study Center. The evaluation process, which examines everything from scene cuts to how fast-paced content is, maps adolescent development across seven core domains. It looks for things like emotional regulation, kindness, how child-caregiver relationships are modeled in a story, and how a story might support critical thinking or language development.
paras.zh: 正是在新冠疫情期间，谢曼和莱塔开始沉迷于思考如何重新设计儿童媒体。解决方案是什么？ Maka 上播放的每一集都由儿童发展专家通过 Imprint 进行评估，Imprint 是耶鲁儿童研究中心的研究人员创建的一个框架。评估过程检查了从场景剪辑到内容快节奏的所有内容，将青少年的发展映射到七个核心领域。它寻找诸如情绪调节、善良、故事中如何塑造儿童看护者关系以及故事如何支持批判性思维或语言发展等因素。

paras.en: AI-generated content has only added a new wrinkle to kids’ entertainment: videos are incoherent, have no plot, or contain outright misinformation, but are packaged to look like learning. Some of it, as WIRED has previously reported, is disturbingly sexualized, featuring gore and other fetishes.
paras.zh: 人工智能生成的内容只是给孩子们的娱乐增加了新的障碍：视频语无伦次、没有情节，或者包含完全错误的信息，但却被包装成看起来像学习。正如《连线》杂志之前报道的那样，其中一些内容具有令人不安的性色彩，以血腥和其他恋物癖为特色。

paras.en: Michael Robb, director of research at the media literacy nonprofit Common Sense Media, says that on a platform like YouTube, slop videos that have the veneer of education sit side by side with carefully designed educational shows. Robb says YouTube and other kids’ streaming platforms have not done enough to distinguish educational content from slop, which has only made filtering content harder for parents. “Platforms have taken steps to reduce kids’ exposure to age-inappropriate content, and that matters. But ‘not inappropriate’ is a very low bar. There’s a big gulf between that and media created intentionally with kids in mind.”
paras.zh: 媒体素养非盈利组织 Common Sense Media 的研究主管迈克尔·罗伯 (Michael Robb) 表示，在 YouTube 这样的平台上，带有教育外表的视频与精心设计的教育节目并排放置。罗布表示，YouTube 和其他儿童流媒体平台在区分教育内容和垃圾内容方面做得不够，这只会让家长更难过滤内容。 “平台已采取措施减少儿童接触不适宜年龄的内容，这一点很重要。但‘不适宜’的标准非常低。这与专门为儿童打造的媒体之间存在很大差距。”

paras.en: A 2020 study by Common Sense Media on YouTube videos watched by young kids found 75 percent had “weak or no educational value.” Kids also frequently ended up watching ads and content intended for older audiences.
paras.zh: Common Sense Media 2020 年对幼儿观看的 YouTube 视频进行的一项研究发现，75% 的视频“教育价值较弱或没有”。孩子们还经常观看针对年长观众的广告和内容。

paras.en: According to its policy for YouTube Kids, which lets parents approve specific content themselves, YouTube excludes videos that are “deceptive, sensational, or clickbait,” but acknowledges that not every video has been manually reviewed. YouTube also makes clear that automated filtering cannot guarantee every video will be appropriate. “There’s a chance that your child will find content that you don't want them to watch,” the company notes in its support docs.
paras.zh: 根据 YouTube Kids 的政策（允许家长自行批准特定内容），YouTube 排除“欺骗性、耸人听闻或标题诱饵”的视频，但承认并非每个视频都经过人工审核。 YouTube 还明确表示，自动过滤不能保证每个视频都合适。该公司在其支持文档中指出：“您的孩子有可能会发现您不希望他们观看的内容。”

paras.en: Earlier this year, in an effort to encourage better digital literacy among kids, the American Academy of Pediatrics updated its guidance beyond screen time recommendations, urging children to avoid “AI-generated content,” “AI chatbots,” “short-form videos,” and “highly sensationalized content or clickbait.” The guide prioritized quality content and coviewing with parents rather than passive watching.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，为了鼓励孩子们提高数字素养，美国儿科学会更新了屏幕时间建议之外的指南，敦促孩子们避免“人工智能生成的内容”、“人工智能聊天机器人”、“短片视频”和“高度耸人听闻的内容或标题诱饵”。该指南优先考虑优质内容和与家长共同观看，而不是被动观看。

paras.en: Tiffany Munzer, a developmental-behavioral pediatrician and digital media researcher at the University of Michigan, was the lead author on AAP’s “Digital Ecosystems, Children, and Adolescents” policy statement, and tells WIRED in an email that the proliferation of low-quality content has led kids to “miss out on important, slower learning opportunities that promote critical thinking, generate new ideas, and practice stretching their attention spans.”
paras.zh: 密歇根大学的发育行为儿科医生和数字媒体研究员蒂芙尼·芒泽 (Tiffany Munzer) 是 AAP“数字生态系统、儿童和青少年”政策声明的主要作者，她在一封电子邮件中告诉《连线》杂志，低质量内容的泛滥导致孩子们“错过了重要的、缓慢的学习机会，而这些机会可以促进批判性思维、产生新想法和练习扩展注意力。”

paras.en: In April, child advocacy group Fairplay sent a letter, signed by more than 200 organizations and individual experts, asking YouTube to address the spread of AI videos on its platforms, saying AI slop “harms children’s development by distorting their sense of reality, overwhelming their learning processes and hijacking their attention.”
paras.zh: 今年 4 月，儿童权益倡导组织 Fairplay 发出了一封由 200 多个组织和个人专家签署的信函，要求 YouTube 解决人工智能视频在其平台上传播的问题，称人工智能“会扭曲他们的现实感，压垮他们的学习过程并劫持他们的注意力，从而损害儿童的发展”。

paras.en: A YouTube spokesperson tells WIRED that on YouTube Kids, which is meant for kids 12 and under, AI content is limited to a small set of high-quality channels, and parents have the option to block channels entirely. The platform has stricter standards for content made for younger viewers, the company says.
paras.zh: YouTube 发言人告诉《连线》杂志，在面向 12 岁及以下儿童的 YouTube Kids 上，人工智能内容仅限于一小部分高质量频道，家长可以选择完全屏蔽频道。该公司表示，该平台对为年轻观众制作的内容有更严格的标准。

paras.en: For Maka’s business model to succeed, its shows will need to entertain and educate kids while also establishing confidence in parents. “The value that parents want is relief, knowing that what their child is seeing has been vetted by child development experts and everything on Maka they can trust is good for their kid,” Sheiman says.
paras.zh: 为了使 Maka 的商业模式取得成功，其节目需要娱乐和教育孩子，同时也建立家长的信心。 “父母想要的价值是宽慰，知道他们的孩子所看到的已经过儿童发展专家的审查，他们可以信任的 Maka 上的一切都对他们的孩子有好处，”Sheiman 说。

paras.en: Yalda Uhls, a former film executive at Sony and MGM who is now a researcher at UCLA focusing on how media affects the social learning of young children, worries that as AI revolutionizes kids’ streaming content, people who study child development are being left out of the process. “When I was a studio executive, every story meant for children passed through layers of accountable adults,” she says. “But today, algorithms, anonymous creators, and AI tools shape what kids see, and people who study child development are rarely in the room.”
paras.zh: 雅尔达·乌尔斯 (Yalda Uhls) 是索尼和米高梅的前电影高管，现在是加州大学洛杉矶分校的研究员，专注于媒体如何影响幼儿的社交学习。她担心，随着人工智能彻底改变儿童流媒体内容，研究儿童发展的人们将被排除在这一过程之外。 “当我担任工作室主管时，每个针对儿童的故事都会经过层层负责任的成年人，”她说。 “但如今，算法、匿名创作者和人工智能工具塑造了孩子们所看到的东西，而研究儿童发展的人很少在房间里。”

paras.en: “The gatekeepers have been replaced by a metric, minutes watched,” Uhls says. “Nobody in that chain is required to ask what a child is actually learning.”
paras.zh: “看门人已经被一种衡量标准、观察分钟数所取代，”乌尔斯说。 “这个链条中的任何人都不需要询问孩子实际上在学习什么。”

paras.en: One of Maka’s core features is a timer that parents set at the start of every viewing session to help the child wind down off the screen. As the show concludes, a character Maka developed named Scoot appears on the screen to get the child ready to detach from their device. Features like that are the difference between capturing a child’s attention versus earning it, Sheinman says. “So it becomes less of a moment of tension in a family and a moment that the child is prepared for.”
paras.zh: Maka 的核心功能之一是父母在每次观看开始时设置的计时器，以帮助孩子从屏幕上放松下来。节目结束时，Maka 开发的一个名为 Scoot 的角色出现在屏幕上，让孩子准备好脱离设备。谢曼说，这样的特征是吸引孩子注意力和赢得孩子注意力的区别。 “因此，这不再是家庭中的紧张时刻，也是孩子做好准备的时刻。”

paras.en: The founders ultimately want Maka to help change the perception of kids' relationship to screens.
paras.zh: 创始人最终希望 Maka 帮助改变孩子们与屏幕关系的看法。

paras.en: “We’re seeing a really big challenge around the judgment of parents,” says Leta, explaining that one problem with screen time is the demonization of parents who rely on it. “We have all judged parents who bring out the screen on the train or at a restaurant. Let's be real, most parents will reach for the screen at some point. We don't think that they should be judged for that choice.”
paras.zh: 莱塔说：“我们看到父母的判断面临着巨大的挑战。”她解释说，屏幕时间的一个问题是对依赖屏幕时间的父母的妖魔化。 “我们都遇到过在火车上或餐厅里拿出屏幕而受到评判的父母。说实话，大多数父母都会在某个时候伸手去拿屏幕。我们认为他们不应该因为这种选择而受到评判。”

paras.en: Whether any of this will work is unclear. One question at the core of Maka’s mission is whether it can build a successful streaming company without adopting the same incentives that created the problems it is trying to solve.
paras.zh: 这些是否有效尚不清楚。 Maka 使命的核心问题是，如果不采取与它试图解决的问题相同的激励措施，它是否能够建立一家成功的流媒体公司。

paras.en: Robb from Common Sense Media calls competing with YouTube a Herculean task. “YouTube is free and already on the devices within their homes. Moving them away can be tricky,” he says. The real test for Maka, Robb says, “will be whether it can grow with kids and stay sustainable without being pulled back toward the engagement metrics that drive the rest of the industry.”
paras.zh: Common Sense Media 的 Robb 称与 YouTube 竞争是一项艰巨的任务。 “YouTube 是免费的，并且已经在他们家中的设备上。将它们移走可能很棘手，”他说。罗布表示，对 Maka 来说，真正的考验是“它是否能够与孩子们一起成长并保持可持续发展，而不会被拉回推动行业其他部分的参与度指标。”

paras.en: Leta, one of Maka’s cofounders, admits that it’s easy to be cynical when it comes to children and screens. “But TV also gave us Sesame Street. It gave us Fred Rogers who believed that the space between the child and the screen was sacred ground.”
paras.zh: Maka 的联合创始人之一莱塔承认，当谈到儿童和屏幕时，人们很容易变得愤世嫉俗。 “但电视也给了我们芝麻街。它给了我们弗雷德·罗杰斯，他相信孩子和屏幕之间的空间是神圣的。”

paras.en: “One of the dads in our beta told us that with other platforms, when his kid is watching, it feels like ‘a race to the bottom of my kid’s brainstem,’” Leta says. “It doesn't have to be like that.”
paras.zh: “我们测试版中的一位爸爸告诉我们，在其他平台上，当他的孩子观看时，感觉就像是‘一场竞赛到我孩子脑干的底部’，”莱塔说。 “事情不必是这样的。”

articles.title: Junji Ito’s Manga Horrors Hit Harder as Live-Action TV
articles.author: Max Evry

paras.en: “It definitely makes you wonder truly who is the real monster in the situation.”
paras.zh: “这肯定会让你真正想知道谁是这种情况下真正的怪物。”

paras.en: Director Yûta Shimotsu is describing events in a new episode of live-action J-horror anthology show Strange: Junji Ito's Tales for Sleepless Nights, but he could be referring to almost any episode.
paras.zh: 导演下津雄太正在描述真人恐怖选集《奇异博士：伊藤润二的不眠夜故事》新一集中的事件，但他可能指的是几乎任何一集。

paras.en: The award-winning manga artist of the title, whose macabre short works are adapted into disturbing 30-minute bites, has a way of blurring lines between protagonist and antagonist amid his surreal nightmares.
paras.zh: 这位获奖漫画家的恐怖短篇作品被改编成令人不安的 30 分钟片段，在超现实的噩梦中模糊了主角和对手之间的界限。

paras.en: Tales for Sleepless Nights aired its 12-episode first season on TV Tokyo this summer, and now HBO Max is bringing those eerie frights to US audiences. The first two installments “Lovesickness (Part 1 of 3)” and “The Bully” (previously animated for Netflix’s Junji Ito Maniac) are currently available, but New York Comic Con fans were treated to the US premiere of the episode “Face Thief” based on Ito’s story “The Face Burglar.”
paras.zh: 今年夏天，《不眠之夜的故事》在东京电视台播出了 12 集的第一季，现在 HBO Max 正在为美国观众带来这些令人毛骨悚然的恐怖故事。前两部《Lovesickness (Part 1 of 3)》和《The Bully》（之前为 Netflix 的 Junji Ito Maniac 制作的动画）现已上映，但纽约动漫展的粉丝们还看到了根据伊藤的故事《The Face Burglar》改编的剧集《Face Thief》的美国首映。

paras.en: “Face Thief,” which was previously turned into a Japanese TV movie in 2000, follows the new girl in school, Machida (Nanami Yamazaki), who encounters a weirdly clingy classmate named Kamei (Anna Hoshino). After she sees an identical-looking girl in class who claims she is not related to Kamei, Machida learns this changeling’s MO: “She befriends cute girls then steals their faces.” Indeed, Kamei’s face begins shifting during close conversations with Machida. This repulses the new girl at first, but when Kamei scares away some bullies by growing a third eyeball on her cheek, the two start to bond.
paras.zh: 《偷脸贼》曾于 2000 年被改编成日本电视电影，讲述了新入学的女孩町田（山崎七海饰）遇到了一位奇怪粘人的同学龟井（星野安娜饰）的故事。在课堂上看到一个长相一模一样的女孩声称自己与龟井没有血缘关系后，町田了解到了这个换生灵的作风：“她和可爱的女孩交朋友，然后偷走了她们的脸。”事实上，在与町田密切交谈时，龟井的脸色开始发生变化。起初，这让新女孩感到排斥，但当龟井在她的脸颊上长出第三个眼球，吓跑了一些恶霸时，两人开始建立联系。

paras.en: We will not spoil the outcome, but the filmmaker turns it into a biting critique of the conformity and peer pressure common in Japanese society. As he told the crowd after the premiere, “We have social pressure that we are supposed to not to be too different from others. Individuality is not very respected.”
paras.zh: 我们不会破坏结果，但电影制片人把它变成了对日本社会普遍存在的顺从和同侪压力的尖锐批评。正如他在首映后告诉观众的那样，“我们面临着社会压力，要求我们不要与其他人有太大不同。个性并没有得到充分尊重。”

paras.en: Despite Shimotsu’s desire to shape-shift the story by “changing the ending so my live-action version was different,” “Face Thief” still manages to capture the slow burn feel of the original comic published in the pages of Monthly Halloween in 1987, the same year Ito’s famous debut Tomie appeared. That shōjo (for girls) manga magazine’s offshoot Nemuki (“Strange Stories of Sleepless Nights") inspired the new TV omnibus’s title.
paras.zh: 尽管下津希望通过“改变结局，让我的真人版本有所不同”来改变故事，《偷脸贼》仍然成功地捕捉到了 1987 年《万圣节月刊》上发表的原版漫画慢慢燃烧的感觉，同年，伊藤富江的著名处女作也出现了。该少女漫画杂志的分支 Nemuki（《不眠之夜的奇怪故事》）启发了新电视综合剧的标题。

paras.en: Junji Ito himself, now a bespectacled 63-year-old, appeared before NYCC in a video message where he described “Face Burglar” as an early tale he came up with after several unsuccessful stories submitted to his publishers: “Not a ghost, just a unique condition inspired by chameleon camouflage.” Ito added that the new adaptation for Tales for Sleepless Nights was “brought to life by a fresh team of upcoming actors and directors. Rather than jump scares, it builds a slow creeping dream perfect for horror.”
paras.zh: 伊藤润二现年 63 岁，戴着眼镜，在纽约CC 的一段视频信息中，他将《面盗》描述为他在向出版商提交了几篇不成功的故事后构思出的一个早期故事：“不是鬼魂，只是受变色龙迷彩启发的独特情况。”伊藤补充道，《不眠之夜故事集》的新改编“由即将到来的演员和导演组成的新团队将其变为现实。它不是跳跃式的惊吓，而是构建了一个缓慢蠕动的梦境，非常适合恐怖。”

paras.en: Another means through which Shimotsu (Best Wishes to All, Shudder’s New Group) finds the essence of Ito in all the episodes he helmed is through stillness in the performances and camerawork that evokes the comic book pages. He told a fan that he hopes to push fidelity to the material one step further in season 2 by shooting at least one episode in black-and-white, Ito’s preferred mode of illustration.
paras.zh: 下津（《向所有人致以最美好的祝愿》、《舒德的新组合》）在他执导的所有剧集中发现伊藤精髓的另一种方式是通过令人想起漫画书页面的表演和摄影作品中的静止。他告诉一位粉丝，他希望在第二季中以黑白方式拍摄至少一集，从而进一步提高材料的保真度，这是伊藤喜欢的插图模式。

paras.en: When asked by a con attendee which of Ito’s works he would most like to adapt next, the director earned applause by answering Uzumaki, the groundbreaking horror manga which has been brought to the screen several times, including a recent 4-part anime series for Adult Swim. The latter version had a famously rocky production, with quality diving after the first episode to the point that the fourth installment had no director credit. A new live-action version would be incredible—and incredibly strange—in Yûta Shimotsu’s hands.
paras.zh: 当一位与会者问他下一步最想改编伊藤的哪一部作品时，导演回答了《漩涡》，赢得了掌声。《漩涡》是一部开创性的恐怖漫画，已多次被搬上银幕，包括最近为《成人游泳》制作的四集动画系列。后一个版本的制作出了名的不稳定，第一集之后质量就下降到第四集没有导演的功劳。如果新的真人版出自下津雄太之手，将会令人难以置信，而且极其奇怪。

paras.en: “I would love to keep creating very bizarre, unique aesthetics like Mr. Ito's work. That's my goal,” said Shimotsu. “I'm developing a Hollywood project, so see you soon.”
paras.zh: “我很乐意继续创造非常奇异、独特的美学，就像伊藤先生的作品一样。这就是我的目标，”Shimotsu 说。 “我正在开发一个好莱坞项目，很快再见。”

articles.title: White House Press Secretary Katie Zacharia Was an Affiliate Marketer for a Fitness MLM
articles.author: Tess Owen, Tim Marchman

paras.en: Since her first appearance behind the podium this week, White House press secretary Katie Zacharia’s past has become murkier by the day.
paras.zh: 自从本周首次登上讲台以来，白宫新闻秘书凯蒂·扎卡里亚的过去变得越来越扑朔迷离。

paras.en: A WIRED review of deleted social media and professional networking profiles has helped clear up at least one mystery. Zacharia’s online resume shows a gap extending from 2013 to late 2023. For part of that time, she worked as an affiliate of Beachbody, a fitness company that ran a multilevel marketing operation she describes to WIRED as “sort of a pyramid scheme.”
paras.zh: 《连线》杂志对已删除的社交媒体和专业网络资料进行的审查至少帮助澄清了一个谜团。扎卡里亚的在线简历显示了从 2013 年到 2023 年末的一段空白。在那段时间里，她曾担任 Beachbody 的附属公司，这家健身公司经营着多层次的营销业务，她向《连线》杂志描述为“有点像金字塔计划”。

paras.en: Zacharia’s background prior to her emergence as a right-wing operative and pundit in recent years has been the subject of intense curiosity. Prior to joining the White House’s press team, she was a spokesperson for the Department of Homeland Security, a communications advisor at President Donald Trump’s media company, and a commentator on Newsmax and Fox News.
paras.zh: 扎卡里亚近年来成为右翼特工和专家之前的背景一直是人们强烈好奇​​的话题。在加入白宫新闻团队之前，她曾担任国土安全部发言人、唐纳德·特朗普总统媒体公司的通讯顾问以及 Newsmax 和福克斯新闻的评论员。

paras.en: Other parts of her professional background have come under scrutiny, particularly her legal work. According to her LinkedIn, Zacharia was an associate at the Zhong Lun law firm, known in China as a top tier “red circle” firm, between 2011 and 2013. She also identifies herself on LinkedIn as having worked as general counsel for the nonprofit Fix California. Tax filings reviewed by WIRED, though, show that rather than working as general counsel for Fix California, Zacharia was in fact a fundraiser for the nonprofit.
paras.zh: 她的专业背景的其他部分也受到了审查，尤其是她的法律工作。根据她的 LinkedIn 信息，Zacharia 于 2011 年至 2013 年间担任中伦律师事务所的律师，该律师事务所在中国被称为顶级“红圈”律师事务所。她还在 LinkedIn 上自称曾担任非营利组织 Fix California 的总法律顾问。不过，《连线》杂志审查的税务申报显示，扎卡里亚并不是 Fix California 的总法律顾问，而是该非营利组织的筹款人。

paras.en: On Tuesday, journalist Judd Legum reported that Zacharia—who, he noted, was identified as an attorney in at least 18 appearances on Fox News—did not appear to have ever passed the bar. Since then, The Wall Street Journal has reported that she sat for the California bar exam but never passed—a finding WIRED independently confirmed. (On Wednesday, watchdog organization Campaign for Accountability filed a complaint with the State Bar of California seeking to investigate the veracity of Zacharia’s claims to be an attorney.)
paras.zh: 周二，记者贾德·勒古姆 (Judd Legum) 报道称，扎卡里亚 (Zacharia) 似乎从未通过律师资格考试，他指出，扎卡里亚至少 18 次在福克斯新闻 (Fox News) 上露面，被确认为律师。此后，《华尔街日报》报道称，她参加了加州律师考试，但从未通过——《连线》杂志独立证实了这一发现。 （周三，监督组织问责运动向加利福尼亚州律师协会提出申诉，寻求调查扎卡里亚自称律师的真实性。）

paras.en: WIRED was able to gain some clarity about other aspects of Zacharia’s professional history using a database of material leaked online created by the open-source intelligence firm District 4 Labs. It contains details from a since-deleted LinkedIn account belonging to Zacharia, which listed Beachbody email addresses as two of her points of contact. A representative for the company told WIRED there was no record of her having worked there. In a phone call, Zacharia confirmed to WIRED that she had never been employed by the company.
paras.zh: 《连线》杂志利用开源情报公司 District 4 Labs 创建的在线泄露材料数据库，对扎卡里亚职业历史的其他方面有了一些了解。其中包含扎卡里亚 (Zacharia) 已删除的 LinkedIn 帐户的详细信息，该帐户将 Beachbody 的电子邮件地址列为她的两个联系人。该公司的一名代表告诉《连线》杂志，没有她在那里工作过的记录。扎卡里亚在电话中向《连线》杂志证实，她从未受过该公司的雇佣。

paras.en: Zacharia says she was, rather, an affiliate marketer for Beachbody, following her 2013 return from China. She recalls being brought in by a friend and promoting its Shakeology product, which is promoted as a “superfood nutrition shake.” She stopped using and promoting the product, she says, because of its vitamin A content, which she didn’t feel was good for her while pregnant.
paras.zh: Zacharia 表示，她 2013 年从中国回国后，成为了 Beachbody 的联盟营销人员。她回忆起被朋友带进来推销其 Shakeology 产品的情景，该产品被宣传为“超级食品营养奶昔”。她说，她停止使用和推广该产品是因为它含有维生素 A，她觉得维生素 A 在怀孕期间对她没有好处。

paras.en: Beachbody, now known as BODi, confirmed in a statement that Zacharia was among its 300,000 “independent Team Beachbody distributors” in 2013. A spokesperson added that they believed it would be “misrepresentation” to conflate Zacharia’s time at Beachbody with “BODi’s current business and operations.”
paras.zh: Beachbody（现称为 BODi）在一份声明中证实，2013 年，Zacharia 是其 300,000 名“独立团队 Beachbody 分销商”之一。一位发言人补充说，他们认为将 Zacharia 在 Beachbody 的时间与“BODi 目前的业务和运营”混为一谈是“失实陈述”。

paras.en: Perhaps unsurprisingly for a company that relied on a multilevel marketing scheme for decades, the company has run into a number of legal issues over the years. It's been accused of falsely advertising a revolutionary anti-aging treatment (the suit was voluntarily dismissed), and making false or misleading income promises to contractors. It got into a copyright battle with a company called orderlegalsteroids.com, accusing it of stealing an image of Israeli bodybuilder Sagi Kalev from promotional materials for their “BODY BEAST” Program. (Beachbody won a default judgment.)
paras.zh: 对于一家几十年来依赖多层次营销计划的公司来说，多年来遇到了许多法律问题，这也许并不奇怪。它被指控虚假宣传一种革命性的抗衰老疗法（该诉讼被自愿驳回），并向承包商做出虚假或误导性的收入承诺。它与一家名为 orderlegalsteroids.com 的公司发生版权纠纷，指控该公司从其“BODY BEAST”计划的宣传材料中窃取了以色列健美运动员 Sagi Kalev 的照片。 （Beachbody 赢得了缺席判决。）

paras.en: In 2017, Beachbody, without admitting any wrongdoing, settled a $3.6 million consumer protection lawsuit with the city attorney in Santa Monica, California. Prosecutors alleged that Beachbody made health-related claims about its products, including Shakeology, that were “false, misleading, and not backed by scientific evidence.” They also claimed in filings that Beachbody had been automatically charging customers credit cards for renewals of their products without their consent. As part of its settlement, Beachbody was ordered to pay $1 million to nonprofits that promote health and nutrition.
paras.zh: 2017年，Beachbody在不承认任何不当行为的情况下，与加利福尼亚州圣莫尼卡市检察官就一项价值360万美元的消费者保护诉讼达成和解。检察官指控 Beachbody 对其产品（包括 Shakeology）做出与健康相关的声明，这些声明“虚假、具有误导性，且没有科学证据支持”。他们还在文件中声称，Beachbody 在未经客户同意的情况下，自动向客户的信用卡收取产品续订费用。作为和解协议的一部分，Beachbody 被责令向促进健康和营养的非营利组织支付 100 万美元。

paras.en: And in 2023, Beachbody was hit with a class action lawsuit accusing it of scamming its coaches. The lead plaintiff was a schoolteacher who alleged she joined Beachbody with the hope of making a supplementary income, but ended up paying $20,000 in personal funds to cover expenses related to her coaching role—all while making about $50 per month for about 50 hours of work. The following year, the company dropped its multilevel marketing program in favor of a “single-level affiliate” one. In 2025, it reached a settlement in the class action suit that resulted in the dismissal of all claims, and the lawsuit was later formally dismissed.
paras.zh: 2023 年，Beachbody 遭到集体诉讼，指控其欺骗教练。主要原告是一名学校教师，她声称自己加入 Beachbody 的目的是为了获得额外收入，但最终支付了 20,000 美元的个人资金来支付与她的教练角色相关的费用，同时大约 50 小时的工作每月赚取约 50 美元。第二年，该公司放弃了多层次营销计划，转而采用“单级附属机构”计划。 2025年，它在集体诉讼中达成和解，导致所有索赔被驳回，诉讼随后被正式驳回。

paras.en: In a statement to WIRED, BODi says, “Team Beachbody was a peer-to-peer sales and support network” and that the company “helped tens of millions of people pursue their health goals through in home fitness programs like P90X, Insanity, and 21 Day Fix, and nutrition products such as Shakeology.”
paras.zh: BODi 在给《连线》的一份声明中表示，“Team Beachbody 是一个点对点的销售和支持网络”，该公司“通过 P90X、Insanity 和 21 Day Fix 等家庭健身计划以及 Shakeology 等营养产品，帮助数以千万计的人实现了自己的健康目标。”

paras.en: This particular notch on Zacharia’s resume puts her in good company with other high-profile Trumpworld personnel, a cadre of professionals who have a great fondness for supplement-related business opportunities. FBI chief Kash Patel previously promoted supplements that promised to help people “detox” from the Covid-19 vaccine. Nicole Saphier, Trump’s nominee for surgeon general, reported receiving nearly $300,000 in business income from her own company that owns a supplement line. And Donald Trump himself once oversaw a multilevel marketing company, The Trump Network, which sold an array of vitamins, home urine tests claiming to test for vitamin deficiency, and children's snacks.
paras.zh: 扎卡里亚简历上的这一特殊之处使她与特朗普世界的其他知名人士有良好的合作关系，这些人员是一群非常喜欢与补充剂相关的商业机会的专业人士。 FBI 局长卡什·帕特尔 (Kash Patel) 此前曾推销过承诺帮助人们从 Covid-19 疫苗中“排毒”的补充剂。特朗普提名的卫生局局长妮可·萨菲尔 (Nicole Saphier) 报告称，她从自己拥有补充产品线的公司获得了近 30 万美元的商业收入。唐纳德·特朗普本人也曾管理过一家多层次营销公司“特朗普网络”，该公司销售一系列维生素、声称可以检测维生素缺乏症的家庭尿液检测仪以及儿童零食。

articles.title: Philadelphia Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts out with blood clot

paras.en: Oct. 15 (UPI) -- Philadelphia Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts will not play in Week 6 due to a superficial blood clot in his leg, the team announced Thursday.
paras.zh: 10 月 15 日（合众国际社）——费城老鹰队周四宣布，四分卫杰伦·赫茨因腿部浅表血块将缺席第六周比赛。

paras.en: Hurts was listed with a calf injury, but was a full participant at Wednesday's practice. He also was listed with a calf injury last week, but still played in the Eagles' 19-17 loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars on Sunday in London.
paras.zh: 赫茨因小腿受伤而被列入名单，但他完全参加了周三的训练。上周他也因小腿受伤而被列入名单，但周日在伦敦老鹰队以 19-17 输给杰克逊维尔美洲虎队的比赛中他仍然参加了比赛。

paras.en: Tanner McKee is now in line to start for the Eagles on Sunday against the Carolina Panthers.
paras.zh: 坦纳·麦基现在有望在周日对阵卡罗莱纳黑豹队的比赛中为老鹰队首发。

paras.en: The Eagles said Hurts visited the training room Oct. 8 and requested treatment on the calf after he was cleated during a Week 4 loss to the Los Angeles Rams.
paras.zh: 老鹰队表示，赫茨在第 4 周输给洛杉矶公羊队的比赛中受伤后，于 10 月 8 日前往训练室，并要求对小牛进行治疗。

paras.en: An ultrasound, performed Saturday, revelaed the superficial blood clot.
paras.zh: 周六进行的超声波检查显示了浅表血凝块。

paras.en: "Our medical staff and doctors in London reviewed the results and concluded that activity and mobility were important and that Jalen could safely play," the Eagles said. "Doctors recommended a follow-up ultrasound within 72 hours of the game and the return flight to Philadelphia."
paras.zh: 老鹰队表示：“我们在伦敦的医务人员和医生审查了结果，得出的结论是活动和活动能力很重要，贾伦可以安全地参加比赛。” “医生建议在比赛结束后 72 小时内进行超声检查并返回费城。”

paras.en: The Eagles said he played without limitation Sunday and received treatment Monday and Tuesday.
paras.zh: 老鹰队表示，他周日不受限制地参加比赛，周一和周二接受了治疗。

paras.en: "On Wednesday night, a follow-up ultrasound revealed movement in the small blood clot," the Eagles said. "Jalen will be out for Sunday's game versus the Panthers as we determine the appropriate course of treatment. His health and safety are our highest priority."
paras.zh: 老鹰队表示：“周三晚上，后续超声波检查显示小血块有运动。” “贾伦将缺席周日对阵黑豹队的比赛，我们将确定适当的治疗方案。他的健康和安全是我们的首要任务。”

paras.en: Hurts completed 57.8% of his throws for 933 yards, eight scores and three interceptions through his first five starts of the season. He also ran for 107 yards and a score.
paras.zh: 赫茨在本赛季的前五场首发中，传球成功率为 57.8%，推进 933 码，取得 8 次得分和 3 次拦截。他还跑出了107码并得分。

paras.en: McKee, a sixth-round pick in the 2023 NFL Draft, has yet to appear in a game this season. He completed 24 of 43 passes for 274 yards, one score and an interception over four appearances last season for the Eagles. Cole Payton is the Eagles' third-string quarterback.
paras.zh: 麦基是 2023 年 NFL 选秀的第六轮新秀，本赛季尚未出场。上赛季他为老鹰队出场4次，43次传球完成24次，推进274码，取得1次得分和1次拦截。科尔·佩顿是老鹰队的三号线四分卫。

paras.en: The Eagles (2-3) will host the Panthers (2-2) at 1 p.m. EDT Sunday in Philadelphia.
paras.zh: 老鹰队 (2-3) 将在下午 1 点主场迎战黑豹队 (2-2)。美国东部时间周日在费城。

articles.title: Judge extends block on Trump’s ‘paid for by U.S. government’ ads

paras.en: Oct. 15 (UPI) -- A federal judge has extended the block on President Donald Trump's campaign-style commercials featuring disclaimers that they are paid for by the U.S. government.
paras.zh: 10 月 15 日（合众国际社）——一名联邦法官延长了对唐纳德·特朗普总统的竞选风格广告的禁令，这些广告中包含免责声明，这些广告是由美国政府付费的。

paras.en: U.S. District Judge Jennifer Rochon ruled Wednesday that the ads will remain blocked until Nov. 8, following up on the initial 14 day restraining order against them. Despite that original order blocking the ads they continued to air earlier this week.
paras.zh: 美国地区法官 Jennifer Rochon 周三裁定，这些广告将在 11 月 8 日之前继续被屏蔽，这是针对这些广告最初发出的 14 天限制令的后续行动。尽管最初的命令屏蔽了这些广告，但它们在本周早些时候仍继续播出。

paras.en: The ad campaign, paid for to the tune of $20 million in taxpayer dollars, includes five commercials heavily featuring Trump. In at least one of the commercials, dubbed the "Final Battle," Trump makes thinly-veiled comments about political opponents, calling them a "sick political class that hates our country."
paras.zh: 此次广告活动耗资约 2000 万美元，其中包括 5 个以特朗普为主角的广告。至少在一个被称为“最后之战”的广告中，特朗普对政治对手做出了毫不掩饰的评论，称他们是“仇恨我们国家的病态政治阶层”。

paras.en: "We are very pleased that the court extended the temporary restraining order, the emergency relief that we had already received in this case, to ensure that the plainly illegal ads remain off the air and clear of further dissemination," said Renata O'Donnell, senior legal counsel for strategic litigation at Campaign Legal Center.
paras.zh: 竞选法律中心战略诉讼高级法律顾问雷娜塔·奥唐纳 (Renata O'Donnell) 表示：“我们很高兴法院延长了临时限制令，这是我们在本案中已经获得的紧急救济，以确保这些明显非法的广告不再播出，并且不会进一步传播。”

paras.en: The extension of the block takes the commercials off the air through the Nov. 3 midterms. The ad campaign is part of Trump's media blitz as he encourages voters to vote for Republicans, who hold a narrow majority in Congress.
paras.zh: 由于街区的延伸，该广告将在 11 月 3 日中期选举期间停播。该广告活动是特朗普媒体闪电战的一部分，因为他鼓励选民投票给在国会中占据微弱多数的共和党人。

paras.en: Trump and Vice President JD Vance have framed the commercials as public service announcements and claimed that they are not partisan.
paras.zh: 特朗普和副总统 JD 万斯将这些广告定义为公共服务公告，并声称它们没有党派之争。

paras.en: A White House spokesperson told Politico that the last commercial paid for by the government aired on Sunday. However, at least two commercials were aired on Monday. The Department of Justice apologized for those commercials airing.
paras.zh: 白宫发言人告诉 Politico，政府出资的最后一个广告已于周日播出。然而，周一至少播出了两则广告。司法部对播放的这些广告表示歉意。

articles.title: Watch: Ohio horse's tail confirmed as the longest in the world

paras.en: Oct. 15 (UPI) -- An Ohio horse's hair earned her a Guinness World Record when her tail was officially measured at 13 feet and 6 inches long.
paras.zh: 10 月 15 日（UPI）——一匹俄亥俄马的尾巴被官方测量为 13 英尺 6 英寸长，为她赢得了吉尼斯世界纪录。

paras.en: Jenny, a horse owned by Mackenzie Lowe and Rachel Estes, was a gift for Lowe's 13th birthday in 2019.
paras.zh: 珍妮 (Jenny) 是 Mackenzie Lowe 和 Rachel Estes 拥有的一匹马，是 2019 年 Lowe 13 岁生日的礼物。

paras.en: "Before I got her, I was informed when she was younger, she had actually ripped her tail out. By the time I got her, her tail touched the ground but was not long," Lowe told Guinness World Records.
paras.zh: “在我找到她之前，我被告知，当她还小的时候，她实际上已经把尾巴扯掉了。当我找到她时，她的尾巴已经接触到了地面，但并不长，”洛告诉吉尼斯世界纪录。

paras.en: Jenny is an American saddlebred, a breed known for their long and flowing tails.
paras.zh: 珍妮是美国马鞍犬，该品种以其长而飘逸的尾巴而闻名。

paras.en: "We decided to let it grow since a longer tail is something looked for with this breed when showing. Over time, it kept growing and so we decided to see how long it could get and eventually to go for the world record," Lowe said.
paras.zh: “我们决定让它继续生长，因为这个品种在展示时需要更长的尾巴。随着时间的推移，它不断生长，所以我们决定看看它能长到多长，并最终打破世界纪录，”洛说。

paras.en: Jenny was finally given a tail trim after her 13-foot, 6-inch tail was confirmed to have beaten the previous record of 12 feet and 6 inches, which was set in 2007.
paras.zh: 珍妮的13英尺6英寸长的尾巴被证实打破了2007年创下的12英尺6英寸的纪录，之后她终于接受了尾巴修剪。

paras.en: "I know Jenny's excited about it," Lowe said. "She's looking forward to not having quite so many long tail groomings."
paras.zh: “我知道珍妮对此很兴奋，”洛说。 “她期待着不要有那么多的长尾巴梳理。”

articles.title: Weezer to Receive Legend of Live Award at 2026 Billboard Live Music Summit
articles.author: Katie Atkinson

paras.en: Weezer will receive the Legend of Live award at the 2026 Billboard Live Music Summit, Billboard announced Thursday (Oct. 15). In addition, the Grammy-winning band will appear in conversation with Billboard co-chief content officer Jason Lipshutz at the Nov. 10 event.
paras.zh: Billboard 周四（10 月 15 日）宣布，Weezer 将在 2026 年 Billboard 现场音乐峰会上获得现场传奇奖。此外，这位格莱美获奖乐队还将在 11 月 10 日的活动中与 Billboard 联合首席内容官 Jason Lipshutz 进行对话。

paras.en: Recognizing artists who have made lasting, significant contributions to the live music and concert touring business, past Legend of Live recipients include Usher, John Mayer, George Strait, Journey, Rush, Ozzy Osbourne and Elton John.
paras.zh: 过去的“Live Legend”获奖者包括亚瑟小子 (Usher)、约翰·梅尔 (John Mayer)、乔治·海峡 (George Strait)、Journey、拉什 (Rush)、奥兹·奥斯本 (Ozzy Osbourne) 和埃尔顿·约翰 (Elton John)，旨在表彰为现场音乐和巡回演唱会业务做出持久、重大贡献的艺术家。

paras.en: Also on Thursday, Billboard announced the latest programming for the Billboard Live Music Summit Presented by VENU, taking place Tuesday, Nov. 10, at the 1 Hotel West Hollywood. Madison Square Garden Entertainment president Josephine Vaccarello — Billboard’s 2026 Touring Executive of the Year — will speak with Billboard senior correspondent Kristin Robinson for a live taping of the Billboard On The Record podcast. CAA’s Shirin Nury, IAG’s Jarred Arfa, TBA’s Josh Mulder, THE·TEAM’s Kevin Shivers, UTA’s Jbeau Lewis and WME’s Robby Fraser will discuss the agency sector and Another Planet Entertainment’s Allen Scott, C3 Presents’ Huston Powell, Dreamshop Management’s Heather Kolker, Goldenvoice’s Melissa Ormond and ROAM’s Jeremy Shpizner will discuss the state of the festival market. Billboard co-chief content officer Leila Cobo will moderate a conversation about international touring with leaders including Live Nation’s Nidhish Varughese and OCESA’s Memo Parra.
paras.zh: 同样在周四，Billboard 宣布了由 VENU 主办的 Billboard 现场音乐峰会的最新节目，该峰会将于 11 月 10 日星期二在西好莱坞 1 号酒店举行。麦迪逊广场花园娱乐公司总裁约瑟芬·瓦卡雷洛（Josephine Vaccarello）——《公告牌》2026 年度巡回演出高管——将与《公告牌》高级记者克里斯汀·罗宾逊进行对话，现场录制《公告牌》播客。 CAA 的 Shirin Nury、IAG 的 Jarred Arfa、TBA 的 Josh Mulder、THE·TEAM 的 Kevin Shivers、UTA 的 Jbeau Lewis 和 WME 的 Robby Fraser 将讨论代理行业，Another Planet Entertainment 的 Allen Scott、C3 Presents 的 Huston Powell、Dreamshop Management 的 Heather Kolker、Goldenvoice 的 Melissa Ormond 和 ROAM 的 Jeremy Shpizner 将讨论代理行业的状况节日市场。 Billboard 联合首席内容官 Leila Cobo 将与 Live Nation 的 Nidhish Varughese 和 OCESA 的 Memo Parra 等领导人主持一场有关国际巡演的对话。

paras.en: Weezer and the new lineup of executives join previously announced Outstanding Pop Tour of the Year recipient Hilary Duff, who will sit down for an exclusive conversation at the event. Both the summit and awards have been programmed by Billboard senior editor Eric Renner Brown. This year, Billboard will also host a pre-summit opening reception on Monday, Nov. 9, sponsored by THE·TEAM, exclusively for badge holders, with more details to be announced in coming weeks.
paras.zh: 威泽和新的高管阵容加入了之前宣布的年度杰出流行巡演获奖者希拉里·达芙 (Hilary Duff)，她将在活动中坐下来进行独家对话。峰会和颁奖典礼均由 Billboard 高级编辑埃里克·雷纳·布朗 (Eric Renner Brown) 策划。今年，Billboard 还将在 11 月 9 日星期一举办由 THE·TEAM 赞助、专为徽章持有者举办的峰会前开幕招待会，更多细节将在未来几周内公布。

paras.en: Weezer just wrapped the North American leg of The Gathering Tour, which kicked off last month in Sacramento, California, with support acts Silversun Pickups, The Shins and Taking Back Sunday and ended Oct. 11 in Orlando, Florida. The arena tour promoted their Aug. 21-released self-titled Gold Album — the band’s 20th album — which arrived in the top 40 of the all-genre Billboard 200 chart (No. 35) and top 10 on Top Rock Albums (No. 6).
paras.zh: Weezer 刚刚结束了 The Gathering 巡回演唱会的北美站，该巡演于上个月在加利福尼亚州萨克拉门托开始，并得到了 Silversun Pickups、The Shins 和 Take Back Sunday 等乐队的支持，并于 10 月 11 日在佛罗里达州奥兰多结束。这次竞技场巡演宣传了他们于 8 月 21 日发行的同名金专辑（乐队的第 20 张专辑），该专辑进入了 Billboard 200 排行榜所有类型的前 40 名（第 35 名），并在顶级摇滚专辑中排名前 10 名（第 6 名）。

paras.en: Sponsors for the 2026 Live Music Summit Presented by VENU include AEG Presents, Moody Center, Tacoma Dome, THE·TEAM and Allegiant Stadium.
paras.zh: VENU 主办的 2026 年现场音乐峰会的赞助商包括 AEG Presents、Moody Center、Tacoma Dome、THE·TEAM 和 Allegiant Stadium。

paras.en: Tickets are on sale now for the Live Music Summit Presented by VENU, returning Nov. 10 to 1 Hotel West Hollywood. The event will bring together top executives, artists and innovators from across the live entertainment industry for panels, networking opportunities and a special awards ceremony.
paras.zh: 由 VENU 主办的现场音乐峰会门票现已发售，将于 11 月 10 日返回西好莱坞 1 酒店。该活动将汇集现场娱乐行业的高层管理人员、艺术家和创新者，提供座谈会、交流机会和特别颁奖典礼。

paras.en: Last fall, the Billboard Live Music Summit took over the 1 Hotel on Nov. 3, 2025. The day was highlighted by the Legend of Live Keynote panel with Usher, honored following his blockbuster Past Present Future Tour, which ran for 83 international concerts from 2024 to 2025. Latin superstar Rauw Alejandro also sat down for a Spotlight Conversation about his rise to 2025’s Cosa Nuestra Tour, which grossed $91.7 million across spring and summer legs in North America and Europe before heading to South America and Mexico.
paras.zh: 去年秋天，Billboard 现场音乐峰会于 2025 年 11 月 3 日在 1 号酒店举行。这一天的亮点是与 Usher 一起举行的 Legend of Live Keynote 小组讨论，亚瑟小子在他轰动一时的过去现在未来巡演之后，于 2024 年至 2025 年举办了 83 场国际音乐会。拉丁巨星 Rauw Alejandro 也坐下来就他在 2025 年 Cosa Nuestra 巡演中的崛起进行了一场聚光灯对话。在前往南美和墨西哥之前，该片在北美和欧洲的春夏两季收获了 9170 万美元的收入。

articles.title: Zach Bryan, Megan Moroney & Treaty Oak Revival Set for Return of GoldenSky Festival in 2027
articles.author: Jessica Nicholson

paras.en: After a two-year hiatus, the GoldenSky Festival will return to Northern California in 2027, bringing more country music back to the West Coast when it hits Discovery Park in Sacramento on Oct. 9-10, 2027.
paras.zh: 中断两年后，GoldenSky Festival 将于 2027 年重返北加州，并于 2027 年 10 月 9 日至 10 日在萨克拉门托探索公园举行，将更多乡村音乐带回西海岸。

paras.en: Zach Bryan, Megan Moroney, Treaty Oak Revival, Ty Myers, Whiskey Myers, Hudson Westbrook, Max McNown and more are on the lineup, which also features Wyatt Flores, Vincent Mason, Avery Anna, Braxton Keith, Blake Whiten, Waylon Wyatt, Mack Geiger, Kaitlin Butts, Carter Faith, Alexandra Kay, Noah Rinker, The Band Perry, Tyler Nance, Graham Barham, Los Hermanos Mendoza and Fey Fili.
paras.zh: 扎克·布莱恩 (Zach Bryan)、梅根·莫罗尼 (Megan Moroney)、Treaty Oak Revival、泰·迈尔斯 (Ty Myers)、威士忌·迈尔斯 (Whiskey Myers)、哈德森·威斯布鲁克 (Hudson Westbrook)、马克斯·麦克诺 (Max McNown) 等都在阵容中，此外还有怀亚特·弗洛雷斯 (Wyatt Flores)、文森特·梅森 (Vincent Mason)、艾弗里·安娜 (Avery Anna)、布拉克斯顿·基思 (Braxton Keith)、布莱克·怀顿 (Blake Whiten)、韦伦·怀亚特 (Waylon Wyatt)、麦克·盖格 (Mack Geiger)、凯特琳·巴茨 (Kaitlin Butts)、卡特·费思 (Carter Faith)、亚历山德拉·凯 (Alexandra Kay)、诺亚·林克 (Noah Rinker)、The Band Perry、泰勒 (Tyler)南斯、格雷厄姆·巴勒姆、洛斯·赫马诺斯·门多萨和费伊·菲利。

paras.en: The 2027 edition is the first in a three-year commitment that will bring GoldenSky Festival back to Sacramento for 2027, 2028 and 2029.
paras.zh: 2027 年是 GoldenSky Festival 三年承诺中的第一个，该承诺将于 2027 年、2028 年和 2029 年将 GoldenSky Festival 重返萨克拉门托。

paras.en: Next year, the Danny Wimmer Presents-led fest expands its offerings in Discovery Park, with amenities/experiences including The Tailgate, a pregame destination that features local food, happy hour pricing and Bar 1973, an air conditioned, Old West saloon-style space with arcade games. Attendees can also enjoy 3 Pina Coladas: Honky Tonk Luau, a space for tropical frozen drinks. El Dorado Cantina will offer local street tacos and drinks, while Smokehouse Inn will offer California-style tri-tip. Additionally, reimagined versions of GoldenSky Fest fan favorites including River City Dance Hall and Overtime Sports Bar will offer activities such as line-dancing from Sacramento instructors. A new Country Club SVIP space further elevates the fest’s party vibes with a mainstage viewing platform, an air-conditioned lounge, fast-track entry, and food and drinks.
paras.zh: 明年，由 Danny Wimmer Presents 主导的音乐节将在探索公园扩大其服务范围，提供设施/体验，包括 The Tailgate（赛前目的地，提供当地美食、欢乐时光定价）和 Bar 1973（一个配有空调、提供街机游戏的老西部酒吧风格空间）。与会者还可以享用 3 杯 Pina Coladas：Honky Tonk Luau，这是一个供应热带冷冻饮品的空间。 El Dorado Cantina 将提供当地街头炸玉米饼和饮料，而 Smokehouse Inn 将提供加州风格的三小费。此外，River City Dance Hall 和 Overtime Sports Bar 等深受粉丝喜爱的 GoldenSky Fest 的重新设计版本将提供萨克拉门托教练指导的排舞等活动。全新的乡村俱乐部 SVIP 空间设有主舞台观景平台、空调休息室、快速通道以及食物和饮料，进一步提升了节日的派对氛围。

paras.en: “We’ve missed GoldenSky, and after two years away, we knew if we were bringing it back, we needed to come back big,” Chamie McCurry, general manager at Danny Wimmer Presents, said in a statement, adding, “This lineup feels like the perfect return, reflecting what’s exciting in country music right now while staying true to what made people fall in love with GoldenSky in the first place. More importantly, we’re not just coming back for a weekend. We’ve made a long-term commitment to Sacramento, and we’re excited to keep growing GoldenSky and investing in this community for years to come.”
paras.zh: Danny Wimmer Presents 总经理 Chamie McCurry 在一份声明中表示：“我们很怀念 GoldenSky，两年后，我们知道如果要让它回归，我们需要大张旗鼓地回归。”他补充道，“这个阵容感觉像是完美的回归，反映了乡村音乐中令人兴奋的东西，同时也忠于最初让人们爱上 GoldenSky 的原因。更重要的是，我们回来不仅仅是为了一个周末。我们已经做出了长期承诺萨克拉门托，我们很高兴在未来几年继续发展 GoldenSky 并投资这个社区。”

paras.en: “The excitement is already in the air in Sacramento, and we’re ready to welcome GoldenSky back to Discovery Park,” added Visit Sacramento President & CEO Mike Testa. “This event has a proven track record of bringing music fans from across the country to our region, and we’re confident that the 2027 lineup will inspire even more visitors to travel here for an unforgettable festival weekend.”
paras.zh: “萨克拉门托的空气中已经弥漫着兴奋的气氛，我们已准备好欢迎 GoldenSky 回到探索公园，”Visit Sacramento 总裁兼首席执行官 Mike Testa 补充道。 “这项活动在将全国各地的乐迷带到我们地区方面有着良好的记录，我们相信 2027 年的阵容将激励更多的游客来这里度过一个难忘的节日周末。”

paras.en: GoldenSky Festival launched in 2022 and ran through 2024; in that time, GoldenSky welcomed performers including Ashley McBryde, Bailey Zimmerman, Eric Church, Lainey Wilson, Tim McGraw, Shaboozey and Turnpike Troubadours.
paras.zh: 金天节于2022年启动，持续至2024年；当时，GoldenSky 迎来了 Ashley McBryde、Bailey Zimmerman、Eric Church、Lainey Wilson、Tim McGraw、Shaboozey 和 Turnpike Troubadours 等表演者。

articles.title: Here Are Taylor Swift’s Likely Grammy Competitors for Best Song Written for Visual Media
articles.author: Paul Grein

paras.en: Taylor Swift and Jack Antonoff appear to be the Grammy front-runners for best song written for visual media with “I Knew It, I Knew You,” the charming pop/country tune they co-wrote for Toy Story 5. It would be Swift’s second win in this category: “Safe & Sound,” which she co-wrote with T Bone Burnett and The Civil Wars for The Hunger Games, won in 2013.
paras.zh: 泰勒·斯威夫特 (Taylor Swift) 和杰克·安东诺夫 (Jack Antonoff) 凭借《我知道，我知道你》(I Knew It, I Knew You) 成为格莱美最佳视觉媒体歌曲的领跑者，这首歌曲是他们为《玩具总动员 5》共同创作的迷人流行/乡村歌曲。这将是斯威夫特在该类别中第二次获奖：《Safe & Sound》是她在 2013 年与 T Bone Burnett 和《内战》为《饥饿游戏》共同创作的歌曲。

paras.en: Moreover, it would be the second song from this film franchise to win in this category: Randy Newman’s “When She Loved Me” from Toy Story 2 won in 2001. This would mark the first time that songs from two separate installments of a film franchise have won.
paras.zh: 此外，这将是该系列电影中第二首在该类别中获奖的歌曲：2001 年《玩具总动员 2》中兰迪·纽曼 (Randy Newman) 的《When She Loved Me》获奖。这将标志着系列电影中两部独立作品中的歌曲首次获奖。

paras.en: There are 149 songs on this year’s entry list in this category vying for just five or six slots on the final ballot. (The number has varied in recent years.) What other songs are likely to be in the running when the 69th annual Grammy nominations are announced on Nov. 16?
paras.zh: 今年该类别的入围名单中有 149 首歌曲，在最终投票中只争夺五六个席位。 （近年来这个数字有所不同。）当 11 月 16 日宣布第 69 届年度格莱美提名时，还有哪些歌曲可能会参与角逐？

paras.en: Lady Gaga and Doechii have a good chance with “Runway,” which they co-wrote with Dernst “D Mile” Emile II, Jayda Love, Bruno Mars, Cirkut and Andrew Watt for The Devil Wears Prada 2. Gaga is a two-time winner in the category for co-writing “Shallow” (2019) and “I’ll Never Love Again” (2020), both from A Star Is Born. (The Grammy entry list does not list Gaga as a co-writer, but that will likely be corrected if the song makes it to the final ballot.)
paras.zh: Lady Gaga 和 Doechii 在《Runway》中获得了很好的机会，他们与 Dernst“D Mile”Emile II、Jayda Love、Bruno Mars、Cirkut 和 Andrew Watt 共同创作了《穿普拉达的女王 2》的歌曲。Gaga 因与《明星诞生》中的《Shallow》（2019 年）和《I’ll Never Love Again》（2020 年）合写而两次获得该奖项。 （格莱美入围名单并未将 Gaga 列为联合创作者，但如果这首歌进入最终投票，这一点可能会得到纠正。）

paras.en: A second song from The Devil Wears Prada 2 is also in the running: “Material Lover,” which Sienna Spiro co-wrote with Omer Fedi and Michael Pollack. Spiro is one of the likely front-runners for best new artist.
paras.zh: 《穿普拉达的女魔头 2》中的第二首歌曲《Material Lover》也在候选名单中，由西耶娜·斯皮罗 (Sienna Spiro) 与奥马尔·费迪 (Omer Fedi) 和迈克尔·波拉克 (Michael Pollack) 共同创作。斯皮罗可能是最佳新人艺术家的领跑者之一。

paras.en: Ludwig Göransson, who had two nominated songs in the category at the Grammy ceremony earlier this year (“I Lied to You” and “Pale, Pale Moon,” both from Sinners), is entered with “When I’m Home” from The Odyssey (which he co-wrote with James Blake, Travis Scott and the film’s director, Christopher Nolan). The Odyssey is the second-highest grossing film of 2026, behind Spider Man: Brand New Day.
paras.zh: 路德维希·戈兰森 (Ludwig Göransson) 在今年早些时候的格莱美颁奖典礼上获得了两首提名歌曲（《罪人》中的《I Lied to You》和《Pale, Pale Moon》），他凭借《奥德赛》中的《When I'm Home》（他与詹姆斯·布莱克、特拉维斯·斯科特和电影导演克里斯托弗·诺兰共同创作）入围。 《奥德赛》是 2026 年票房第二高的电影，仅次于《蜘蛛侠：全新一天》。

paras.en: Lin-Manuel Miranda, a two-time winner in the category, is entered with “Along the Way” from Moana (which he cowrote with Opetaia Foa’i and Mark Mancina). Miranda’s previous wins are both for songs he wrote by himself: “How Far I’ll Go” from the original Moana and “We Don’t Talk About Bruno” from Encanto.
paras.zh: 两次获得该奖项的林-曼努尔·米兰达 (Lin-Manuel Miranda) 凭借《莫阿娜》(Moana) 的《一路走来》(Along the Way) 参赛（他与 Opetaia Foa’i 和 Mark Mancina 共同创作）。米兰达之前的获奖作品都是他自己创作的歌曲：原版《莫阿娜》中的《我会走多远》和《Encanto》中的《我们不谈论布鲁诺》。

paras.en: Diane Warren, who has received a record 11 nominations in this category, is entered with “By Any Means” from the film of the same name. The Isley Brothers and David Kushner performed the song on the film’s soundtrack. Warren’s only win in the category to date is for “Because You Loved Me” from Up Close & Personal.
paras.zh: 黛安·沃伦 (Diane Warren) 凭借同名电影中的《不惜一切代价》(By Any Means) 入围该类别，创纪录地获得了 11 项提名。艾斯利兄弟和大卫·库什纳在电影配乐中演唱了这首歌。迄今为止，沃伦在该类别中唯一的获奖作品是《Up Close & Personal》的《Because You Loved Me》。

paras.en: Two songs that were best original song nominees at the Oscar ceremony held earlier this year are on the Grammy entry list this year: “Train Dreams” by Nick Cave and Bryce Dessner, from the film of the same name; and “Sweet Dreams of Joy” by Nicholas Pike, from Viva Verdi!
paras.zh: 今年早些时候举行的奥斯卡颁奖典礼上获得最佳原创歌曲提名的两首歌曲也进入了今年的格莱美参赛名单：尼克·凯夫和布莱斯·德斯纳创作的《Train Dreams》，来自同名电影；以及尼古拉斯·派克 (Nicholas Pike) 的《威尔第万岁》的《Sweet Dreams of Joy》！

paras.en: In addition, five songs that were shortlisted for Oscar nominations but didn’t go on to be nominated are on the entry list here, including two songs from Wicked: For Good: “The Girl in the Bubble” and “No Place Like Home.” Stephen Schwartz wrote both songs, which were performed in the film by Ariana Grande and Cynthia Erivo, respectively.
paras.zh: 此外，入围奥斯卡提名但未获得提名的五首歌曲也在此处的入围名单中，其中包括两首《Wicked: For Good》歌曲：《The Girl in the Bubble》和《No Place Like Home》。史蒂芬·施瓦茨创作了这两首歌曲，并分别由爱莉安娜·格兰德和辛西娅·埃里沃在电影中演唱。

paras.en: Other Oscar-shortlisted songs that are on the Grammy entry list are “Dream as One” from Avatar: Fire and Ash (which Miley Cyrus co-wrote with Simon Franglen, Mark Ronson and Andrew Wyatt); “Salt Then Sour Then Sweet” from Come See Me in the Good Light (which Sara Bareilles and Brandi Carlile co-wrote with Andrea Gibson); and “Dying to Live” from Billy Idol Should Be Dead (which Billy Idol and J. Ralph co-wrote with Tommy English, Joe Janiak and Steve Stevens).
paras.zh: 其他入围格莱美候选名单的歌曲包括《阿凡达：火与灰》中的“Dream as One”（麦莉·赛勒斯与西蒙·弗兰格伦、马克·朗森和安德鲁·怀亚特共同创作）； 《Come See Me in the Good Light》（Sara Bareilles、Brandi Carlile 与 Andrea Gibson 合写）中的“Salt then Sour then Sweet”；以及《Billy Idol Should Be Dead》中的《Dying to Live》（Billy Idol 和 J. Ralph 与 Tommy English、Joe Janiak 和 Steve Stevens 共同创作）。

paras.en: Other songs on the entry list that appeared in films that rank among top 25 top-grossing films of the year-to-date in the U.S. and Canada include “Zoo” from Zootopia 2 (which Shakira co-wrote with Ed Sheeran and Blake Slatkin); “House” from Wuthering Heights (written and performed by Charli xcx and John Cale); and “I’m Good” from GOAT (which Jelly Roll co-wrote with John Byron, Ben Johnson, Hunter Phelps and Taylor Philips).
paras.zh: 入围名单上的其他歌曲出现在今年迄今为止美国和加拿大票房收入前 25 名的电影中，包括《疯狂动物城 2》中的“Zoo”（夏奇拉与艾德·希兰和布莱克·斯拉特金共同创作）； 《呼啸山庄》中的“House”（由 Charli xcx 和 John Cale 创作并演唱）；以及《GOAT》中的《I'm Good》（Jelly Roll 与约翰·拜伦、本·约翰逊、亨特·菲尔普斯和泰勒·菲利普斯合写）。

paras.en: Several songs from projects associated with top music personalities are also on the entry list. These include “What Lies With You” from Linda Perry: Let It Die Here (which she wrote); “One in a Long Line” from Lilith Fair: Building a Mystery (Sarah McLachlan & Anne Preven); “Light Up” from Kylie (Duck Blackwell, Luke Fitton, Chris Martin, Kylie Minogue and Richard Stannard); “I’m Never Gonna R.I.P.” from Nimrods (Billie Joe Armstrong, Tré Cool and Mike Dirnt); and “My Cross To Bear from Gregg Allman: The Music of My Soul (Julian Raymond).
paras.zh: 与顶级音乐人物相关的项目中的几首歌曲也在参赛列表中。其中包括琳达·佩里（Linda Perry）的《What Lies With You》：让它死在这里（她写的）； 《莉莉丝集市：建立一个谜团》中的“长队中的一个”（莎拉·麦克拉克兰和安妮·普雷文）；凯莉（达克·布莱克威尔、卢克·菲顿、克里斯·马丁、凯莉·米洛和理查德·斯坦纳德）的《Light Up》； “我永远不会安息。”来自 Nimrods（比利·乔·阿姆斯特朗、Tré Cool 和 Mike Dirnt）；以及格雷格·奥尔曼的《我要承受的十字架：我灵魂的音乐》（朱利安·雷蒙德）。

paras.en: And don’t forget about: “How to Write a Song Without You (Pop Version)” from Power Ballad (written by John Carney and Gary Clark and performed by Nick Jonas).
paras.zh: 不要忘记：《Power Ballad》中的“How to Write a Song Without You（流行版）”（由约翰·卡尼和加里·克拉克创作，由尼克·乔纳斯演唱）。

paras.en: Because this Grammy category includes songs written for TV and other visual media in addition to film, the entry list includes “Need Someone” from The Pitt, which won a Primetime Emmy last month for outstanding original words and music. Andrew Bird wrote the song.
paras.zh: 由于格莱美类别除了电影之外还包括为电视和其他视觉媒体创作的歌曲，因此参赛名单包括皮特乐队的《Need Something》，该歌曲上个月凭借出色的原创歌词和音乐赢得了黄金时段艾美奖。安德鲁·伯德创作了这首歌。

paras.en: The entry list includes four additional songs that were nominated in that Emmy category: “Christian Woman” from South Park (Trey Parker); “Raise Him Up” from The Boys (written by Daveed Diggs, Eric Kripke and Christopher Lennertz); “Mis Figuritas” from Hacks (Carlos Rafael Rivera & David Stal) and “The Devil You Know” from Spider-Noir (Warren Felder, Sebastian Kole, Daniel Pemberton and Jayme Silverstein).
paras.zh: 入围名单中还包括另外四首获得艾美奖提名的歌曲：《南方公园》（特雷·帕克）的《基督教女人》； 《男孩们》中的“Raise Him Up”（由戴维德·迪格斯、埃里克·克里普克和克里斯托弗·伦纳茨创作）； 《Hacks》中的“Mis Figuritas”（卡洛斯·拉斐尔·里维拉和大卫·斯塔尔）以及《Spider-Noir》中的“The Devil You Know”（沃伦·费尔德、塞巴斯蒂安·科尔、丹尼尔·彭伯顿和杰梅·西尔弗斯坦）。

paras.en: A song from this year’s buzziest TV miniseries is also on the entry list – “It’s You” from Heated Rivalry (written by Peter Jones). So is a song from a hot TV soundtrack – “Gravity” from Hazbin Hotel Season 2 (written by Sam Haft and Andrew Underberg).
paras.zh: 今年最热门的电视迷你剧中的一首歌曲也出现在入围名单中——《激烈的竞争》中的“It's You”（由彼得·琼斯创作）。热门电视配乐中的一首歌曲也是如此——《哈兹宾酒店》第二季中的“重力”（由萨姆·哈夫特和安德鲁·安德伯格创作）。

paras.en: So, what songs are likely to be nominated? If there are six nominees, as there have been in three of the last five years, we’ll go with these as our predictions, listed in alphabetical order:
paras.zh: 那么，哪些歌曲有可能获得提名呢？如果有六名提名者（过去五年中有三年是这样），我们将把这些作为我们的预测，按字母顺序列出：

paras.en: - “Along the Way” from Moana (Opetaia Foa’i, Mark Mancina & Lin-Manuel Miranda)
paras.zh: -《莫阿娜》中的《一路走来》（Opetaia Foa’i、Mark Mancina 和 Lin-Manuel Miranda）

paras.en: - “Dream as One” from Avatar: Fire and Ash (Miley Cyrus, Simon Franglen, Mark Ronson & Andrew Wyatt)
paras.zh: - 《阿凡达：火与灰》中的“Dream as One”（麦莉·赛勒斯、西蒙·弗兰格伦、马克·罗森和安德鲁·怀亚特）

paras.en: - “I Knew It, I Knew You” from Toy Story 5 (Jack Antonoff & Taylor Swift)
paras.zh: - 《玩具总动员 5》中的“我知道，我知道你”（杰克·安东诺夫和泰勒·斯威夫特）

paras.en: - “Runway” from The Devil Wears Prada 2 (Dernst “D’Mile” Emile II, Doechii, Jayda Love, Bruno Mars, Cirkut, Andrew Watt & Lady Gaga)
paras.zh: -《穿普拉达的女王 2》中的“跑道”（Dernst “D’Mile” Emile II、Doechii、Jayda Love、Bruno Mars、Cirkut、Andrew Watt 和 Lady Gaga）

paras.en: - “Train Dreams” from Train Dreams (Nick Cave & Bryce Dessner)
paras.zh: -《火车梦想》中的“火车梦想”（尼克·凯夫和布莱斯·德斯纳）

paras.en: - “When I’m Home” from The Odyssey (James Blake, Ludwig Göransson, Christopher Nolan & Travis Scott)
paras.zh: - 《奥德赛》中的“当我在家时”（詹姆斯·布莱克、路德维希·戈兰森、克里斯托弗·诺兰和特拉维斯·斯科特）

articles.title: 1985 Chicago Bears to Get TV Limited Series from Steve Pink, Sunset Lane Media (Exclusive)
articles.author: Borys Kit

paras.en: The story of one of the greatest NFL teams in football history is taking to the field.
paras.zh: 橄榄球历史上最伟大的 NFL 球队之一的故事正在上演。

paras.en: Sunset Lane Media, the banner run by executive-turned-producer David Beaubaire, has optioned Monsters: The 1985 Chicago Bears and the Wild Heart of Football, Rich Cohen’s acclaimed account of one of the most famous teams in American sports, and has assembled an offensive lineup to adapt the story as an event limited series.
paras.zh: 由执行制片人大卫·博贝尔 (David Beaubaire) 经营的日落巷媒体 (Sunset Lane Media) 选择了里奇·科恩 (Rich Cohen) 广受好评的《怪物：1985 年芝加哥熊队和足球狂野之心》，讲述美国体育界最著名的球队之一，并组建了进攻阵容，将这个故事改编成赛事限定系列。

paras.en: Daniel Kunka, who penned the Kevin Hart heist movie Lift and John Cena action movie 12 Rounds, will write the adaptation, with Steve Pink, best known as the helmer of comedies Hot Tub Time Machine and Accepted, attached to direct.
paras.zh: 凯文·哈特抢劫电影《Lift》和约翰·塞纳动作片《12 Rounds》的编剧丹尼尔·昆卡 (Daniel Kunka) 将担任改编剧本，史蒂夫·平克 (Steve Pink) 则将担任导演，史蒂夫·平克最著名的作品是喜剧《热水浴缸时间机器》 (Hot Tub Time Machine) 和《接受》 (Accepted)。

paras.en: Cohen, Beaubaire, Kunka and Pink are all Windy City natives who experienced this exhilarating run firsthand. No network or streamer is attached at this stage.
paras.zh: 科恩、博贝尔、昆卡和平克都是风城本地人，亲身经历了这次令人兴奋的跑步。此阶段没有连接网络或流媒体。

paras.en: “This is a love letter to Chicago and to a moment when a city that had waited so long to win finally had a team that seemed unstoppable,” said Beaubaire, who is one of the exec producers of Netflix’s hit series Night Agent. “And the story wasn’t just playing out on the field. It was in the locker room, the stands, the bars and the family rooms across the city. It was riveting, funny, emotional and completely chaotic. We want to recapture that time in all its glory and chaos, remind people why we love these teams and this game so much, and show why, as cities go, Chicago is second to none.”
paras.zh: “这是一封写给芝加哥的情书，写给这座等待了这么久才获胜的城市终于拥有了一支似乎势不可挡的球队的时刻，”博贝尔说，他是 Netflix 热门剧集《夜间特工》的执行制片人之一。 “这个故事不仅仅发生在球场上。它发生在整个城市的更衣室、看台、酒吧和家庭活动室中。它引人入胜、有趣、感人，而且完全混乱。我们希望重现那段辉煌和混乱的时光，提醒人们为什么我们如此热爱这些球队和这场比赛，并展示为什么随着城市的发展，芝加哥是首屈一指的。”

paras.en: The 1985 Chicago Bears dominated football and America’s national consciousness in a way few sports teams had before. They became a national phenomenon at a turning point in sports, when athletes were beginning to become something bigger than what they were on the field.
paras.zh: 1985 年的芝加哥熊队以前所未有的方式统治了足球界和美国的民族意识。在体育运动的转折点，当运动员开始变得比他们在赛场上更伟大的时候，他们成为了一种全国性的现象。

paras.en: The team went 15-1 in the season, shut out both opponents on the road to the Super Bowl, and defeated the New England Patriots 46-10 in Super Bowl XX, which was watched live by more than 92 million people, then the largest television audience in American history.
paras.zh: 球队在赛季中取得了 15 胜 1 负的战绩，在超级碗之路上击败了两个对手，并在第 200 届超级碗比赛中以 46-10 击败了新英格兰爱国者队，现场观看人数超过 9200 万人，创下了美国历史上电视观众人数最多的纪录。

paras.en: But the championship is only part of the story.
paras.zh: 但冠军只是故事的一部分。

paras.en: The Bears landed on the covers of Sports Illustrated, Time and Rolling Stone. The team released a Grammy-nominated single — “Super Bowl Shuffle” — before they had even won the Super Bowl. The team’s coach, Mike Ditka, who died last week, was immortalized in a series of Saturday Night Live sketches.
paras.zh: 熊队登上了《体育画报》、《时代》和《滚石》的封面。该团队在赢得超级碗之前就发行了格莱美提名单曲“Super Bowl Shuffle”。该队的教练迈克·迪特卡上周去世，他在《周六夜现场》的一系列短剧中被永垂不朽。

paras.en: Underneath the phenomenon was an even more remarkable story: a collection of radically different people, enormous personalities, competing egos and sometimes bitter rivalries who somehow became a team united around one goal. And with them were the citizens of a city that had waited decades for a championship and was about to experience something it had almost stopped believing was possible.
paras.zh: 在这一现象的背后，还有一个更引人注目的故事：一群截然不同的人、巨大的个性、相互竞争的自我，有时甚至是激烈的竞争，但不知何故，他们成为了一支围绕同一个目标团结起来的团队。和他们在一起的还有这座城市的公民，这座城市已经等待了几十年的冠军，即将经历一些它几乎不再相信是可能的事情。

paras.en: “What has always fascinated me is that the ’85 Bears have somehow become bigger with time,” stated Cohen, a best-selling author who also co-created the HBO series Vinyl with Martin Scorsese, Mick Jagger and Terence Winter. “The personalities were enormous, the relationships were complicated, and what was happening behind the scenes was often every bit as dramatic as what happened on Sunday. They were funny, angry, brilliant, difficult and completely unforgettable. That is why I wrote the book. The mythology is great. The people underneath it are even better.”
paras.zh: “一直让我着迷的是，随着时间的推移，85 年的熊队在某种程度上变得越来越强大，”畅销书作家科恩说道，他还与马丁·斯科塞斯、米克·贾格尔和特伦斯·温特共同创作了 HBO 剧集《Vinyl》。 “人物性格巨大，关系复杂，幕后发生的事情往往和周日发生的事情一样戏剧性。他们有趣、愤怒、聪明、困难，而且完全令人难忘。这就是我写这本书的原因。神话很棒。神话背后的人更棒。”

paras.en: Off the field, Ditka and defensive coordinator Buddy Ryan battled for control. Running back Walter Payton felt beleaguered, having spent his career carrying a losing franchise. Quarterback Jim McMahon clashed with Ditka. Rookie William “The Refrigerator” Perry became an overnight national sensation. Owner Virginia Halas McCaskey was under intense scrutiny, having just inherited the franchise founded by her father, George “Papa Bear” Halas. All together, they became something none of them could have become alone, personifying the city in which they represented in more ways than one.
paras.zh: 场外，迪特卡和防守协调员巴迪·瑞安争夺控制权。跑卫沃尔特·佩顿感到自己陷入了困境，他的职业生涯一直伴随着一支失败的球队。四分卫吉姆·麦克马洪与迪特卡发生冲突。新秀威廉·“冰箱”·佩里一夜之间轰动全国。店主维吉尼亚·哈拉斯·麦卡斯基 (Virginia Halas McCaskey) 刚刚继承了她父亲“熊爸爸”乔治·哈拉斯 (George“Papa Bear”Halas) 创立的特许经营权，因此受到了严格的审查。总之，他们成为了他们中任何一个人都无法单独成为的人物，以多种方式体现了他们所代表的这座城市。

paras.en: “The story of the ’85 Bears is one of athletic excellence but also about character,” stated Kunka. “These guys didn’t come from the same places; they didn’t see the world the same way. There were feuds, rivalries, egos and real tension. But somehow, they all came together around a single goal. You know how the season ends. What you don’t know is everything it took to get there.”
paras.zh: “85 年熊队的故事不仅是关于卓越运动的故事，也是关于品格的故事，”昆卡说道。 “这些人来自不同的地方；他们看待世界的方式也不同。有不和、竞争、自负和真正的紧张。但不知何故，他们都围绕一个目标聚集在一起。你知道赛季如何结束。你不知道的是到达那里所需要的一切。”

paras.en: The series aims to move between the field, locker room, front office and fans in the city to tell the story of a team becoming a phenomenon and a town discovering something it could believe in together.
paras.zh: 该剧的目的是在球场、更衣室、管理层和这座城市的球迷之间穿梭，讲述一支球队成为一种现象，以及一个小镇发现它可以共同信仰的东西的故事。

paras.en: “I want people in Chicago to watch this and feel like they are back there, and I want everyone who wasn’t there to understand why the rest of us have never shut up about it,” said Pink. “It should be loud, funny, emotional and alive. These were huge characters playing a brutal game in a great American city, and somehow the whole thing became a love story between a team and its town. That’s what I want onscreen.”
paras.zh: 平克说：“我希望芝加哥的人们看到这一幕，感觉自己又回到了那里，我希望所有不在场的人都能理解为什么我们其他人从未对这件事闭嘴。” “它应该是响亮的、有趣的、情感丰富的和生动的。这些都是巨大的角色，在一个伟大的美国城市里玩一场残酷的游戏，不知怎的，整件事变成了一支球队和它的城镇之间的爱情故事。这就是我想要在银幕上看到的。”

articles.title: Sony Considering Bold Plans for 4 Beatles Movies Rollout (Exclusive)
articles.author: James Hibberd

paras.en: Sony Pictures and filmmaker Sam Mendes have been mulling some innovative ideas for the release of their four Beatles biopics — including lumping together the films’ box office returns.
paras.zh: 索尼影业和电影制作人萨姆·门德斯一直在考虑发布四部披头士传记片的一些创新想法，包括将电影的票房回报汇总在一起。

paras.en: The first glimpse of their strategy came over the weekend when Mendes’ producing partner Pippa Harris pulled back the curtain a bit. “We want people to be able to experience them in the cinema at the same time, during the same period,” she said at the BFI London Film Festival’s Industry Forum keynote session. “Now that doesn’t necessarily mean we’re thinking that people will go and see all four films on the same day. But within the same month, you might see one a week, or you might see one film one weekend and another the next.”
paras.zh: 周末，当门德斯的制作搭档皮帕·哈里斯稍微拉开帷幕时，他们的策略首次得以体现。 “我们希望人们能够在同一时间、同一时期在电影院体验它们，”她在 BFI 伦敦电影节行业论坛主题演讲中说道。 “现在这并不一定意味着我们认为人们会在同一天去看所有四部电影。但在同一个月内，你可能每周看一部，或者你可能在一个周末看一部电影，下周末又看另一部电影。”

paras.en: Harris’ comments have been interpreted a couple of different ways — such as the movies potentially being released on different weeks during the same month. But sources tell The Hollywood Reporter the director and the studio have long mulled dropping all four movies the same day.
paras.zh: 哈里斯的评论有几种不同的解读——比如电影可能在同一个月的不同周上映。但消息人士告诉《好莱坞报道》，导演和制片厂长期以来一直在考虑在同一天放弃所有四部电影。

paras.en: In addition, Mendes and the studio have been pondering a highly unique reporting structure for the films’ box office receipts. Instead of releasing each film’s tally individually, the studio has been considering lumping the returns of all four movies together.
paras.zh: 此外，门德斯和工作室一直在考虑一种非常独特的电影票房收入报告结构。该工作室一直在考虑将所有四部电影的回报汇总在一起，而不是单独发布每部电影的票房收入。

paras.en: This would, in effect, prevent the expected horse-race drama of “the John Lennon movie is $12 million more popular than the George Harrison movie,” or whatnot. The ticket sales per movie data would still likely get out into the media from independent sources, however.
paras.zh: 实际上，这将阻止人们所期待的“约翰·列侬电影比乔治·哈里森电影更受欢迎 1200 万美元”之类的赛马戏剧。然而，每部电影的票房数据仍有可能从独立来源进入媒体。

paras.en: “Who’s your favorite Beatle?” has been a topic of conversation and debate that has followed the band since it was first formed, and there’s an understandable reluctance to have the Beatles films put an exact popularity ranking and dollar figure on that question — particularly since the two surviving Beatles, Paul McCartney and Ringo Starr, are actively involved in the films. The legendary musicians have provided feedback on the scripts and met with the respective actors playing their roles (Paul Mescal, Harris Dickinson, Joseph Quinn and Barry Keoghan play Paul, John, George and Ringo, respectively.)
paras.zh: “你最喜欢的披头士乐队是谁？”自乐队成立以来，“披头士乐队”一直是人们谈论和争论的话题，而且人们不愿意让披头士乐队的电影在这个问题上给出准确的受欢迎程度排名和收入数字，这是可以理解的——特别是因为披头士乐队的两位幸存者保罗·麦卡特尼和林戈·斯塔尔都积极参与了这些电影。传奇音乐家对剧本提供了反馈，并会见了扮演各自角色的演员（保罗·梅斯卡尔、哈里斯·迪金森、约瑟夫·奎恩和巴里·基奥根分别扮演保罗、约翰、乔治和林戈。）

paras.en: Another idea being considered is offering a four-pack of tickets to encourage fans to buy tickets to all the movies at once instead of cherrypicking one or two to watch in theaters and saving the rest for streaming. It’s not clear how this one would actually work in practice, however, as it would presumably involving getting the major cinema chains to implement an unusual ticket buying structure.
paras.zh: 正在考虑的另一个想法是提供四包门票，鼓励粉丝一次性购买所有电影的门票，而不是挑选一两部在影院观看，其余的留作流媒体播放。然而，目前尚不清楚这一举措在实践中如何实际运作，因为它可能涉及让主要电影院线实施一种不寻常的购票结构。

paras.en: Assuming all four movies do indeed drop the same week, sources also say the plan is to market the films as not having a particular order — that there will be no “right” order in which to watch the films.
paras.zh: 假设所有四部电影确实在同一周上映，消息人士还表示，该计划是将这些电影作为没有特定顺序的电影进行营销——即不会有“正确”的观看电影的顺序。

paras.en: Each of these fab four ideas point to Mendes and the studio looking for creative solutions to address the broader challenge of getting audiences to watch not just one movie about the Beatles, but a quartet, all told from the perspective of a different member of the band, without giving any one movie more weight or using a structure that pushes one film to potentially cannibalize the audience for another.
paras.zh: 这四个精彩的想法中的每一个都指向门德斯和工作室寻找创造性的解决方案，以应对更广泛的挑战，让观众不仅观看一部关于披头士乐队的电影，而且观看四重奏，所有这一切都是从乐队不同成员的角度讲述的，而不会给任何一部电影更多的重量或使用一种结构，推动一部电影可能会蚕食观众的另一部电影。

paras.en: Sources emphasize that these plans remain fluid amid ongoing discussions and could change.
paras.zh: 消息人士强调，这些计划在正在进行的讨论中仍然不稳定，并且可能会发生变化。

paras.en: The Beatles movies open in April 2028, which Sony doubtless hopes will be a relatively competition-light spot on the calendar to ensure there’s enough space in each market for John, Paul, George and Ringo to get enough screens each.
paras.zh: 披头士乐队的电影将于 2028 年 4 月上映，索尼无疑希望这将是日历上竞争相对较少的时段，以确保每个市场都有足够的空间，让约翰、保罗、乔治和林戈都能获得足够的银幕。

paras.en: Sony Pictures had no comment on the plans.
paras.zh: 索尼影业没有对这些计划发表评论。

articles.title: Creator Duo Slushy Noobz Signs With UTA (Exclusive)
articles.author: Etan Vlessing

paras.en: The Canadian digital creator duo Martin Andrijasevic and Hamzah Al-Emad of the viral YouTube comedy channel Slushy Noobz have signed with United Talent Agency for representation.
paras.zh: YouTube 热门喜剧频道 Slushy Noobz 的加拿大数字创作者二人组 Martin Andrijasevic 和 Hamzah Al-Emad 已与 United Talent Agency 签约代理。

paras.en: Andrijasevic (@ThatMartinKid) and Al Emad (@HamzahTheFantastic) will look to UTA to expand their business opportunities in digital media, comedy touring, filmed entertainment, podcasting, brand ventures and other platforms. Hailing from Canada, Andrijasevic and Al-Emad are also looking to leverage around 1.67 million followers on YouTube to get behind untitled new projects said to be in the works for the Google-owned social video platform.
paras.zh: Andrijasevic (@ThatMartinKid) 和 Al Emad (@HamzahTheFantastic) 将希望 UTA 扩大他们在数字媒体、喜剧巡演、电影娱乐、播客、品牌企业和其他平台方面的商业机会。来自加拿大的 Andrijasevic 和 Al-Emad 也希望利用 YouTube 上约 167 万粉丝来支持据称是谷歌旗下社交视频平台正在开发的未命名新项目。

paras.en: Their ascent on YouTube included a 2025 comedic boxing match between Andrijasevic and Al-Emad, titled Hamzah vs Martin and held in Toronto over three rounds. Slushy Noobz has over million additional followers on Instagram and TikTok for digital content at the intersection of entertainment, music and fashion.
paras.zh: 他们在 YouTube 上的名声大噪包括 2025 年安德里亚塞维奇 (Andrijasevic) 和阿尔-埃马德 (Al-Emad) 之间的一场喜剧拳击比赛，这场比赛名为“哈姆扎 (Hamzah) VS 马丁 (Martin)”，比赛在多伦多举行，共进行三轮。 Slushy Noobz 在 Instagram 和 TikTok 上拥有超过 100 万的粉丝，关注娱乐、音乐和时尚交叉领域的数字内容。
